jobs.description:
**Role Summary:**

The Assistant Registrar – Legal & Compliance will support the Registrar and University leadership in managing legal, regulatory, statutory and governance-related matters of the University. The role will be responsible for monitoring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, University statutes, ordinances and regulatory requirements; supporting the drafting and review of legal and institutional documents; coordinating with external legal counsel and regulatory authorities; and ensuring proper documentation and timely follow-up on legal and compliance matters.

The position will also support the University's statutory bodies, policy development, risk mitigation, and legal aspects of matters relating to students, faculty, staff, contracts, institutional assets and other administrative functions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Legal Affairs & Advisory:**

* Provide legal support and assistance to the Registrar and University leadership on institutional, academic, employment, contractual and administrative matters.
* Draft, review and vet agreements, MoUs, contracts, service agreements, NDAs, undertakings, notices and other legal documents.
* Review legal implications of proposed institutional initiatives, partnerships, contracts and administrative decisions and provide appropriate inputs.
* Coordinate responses to legal notices, claims, disputes and litigation in consultation with the Registrar and external legal counsel.
* Maintain an organised repository of legal documents, agreements, notices, case records and related correspondence.
* Maintain a comprehensive register of agreements/MoUs and monitor their validity, renewal and key contractual obligations.

**Regulatory & Statutory Compliance:**

* Monitor compliance with the applicable University Act, Statutes, Ordinances, UGC Regulations, AICTE requirements, State higher education laws and other applicable statutory/regulatory requirements.
* Track changes in education, employment, labour, data protection and other relevant laws and communicate their implications to concerned stakeholders.
* Coordinate the preparation and submission of statutory returns, reports, declarations and other regulatory filings within prescribed timelines.
* Maintain a compliance calendar and follow up with concerned departments/schools for timely fulfilment of statutory and regulatory requirements.
* Support the University during regulatory inspections, audits, accreditation processes and other statutory reviews from a legal and compliance perspective.
* Assist in identifying gaps in compliance and coordinate appropriate corrective and preventive actions.

**University Governance :**

* Support the functioning of statutory and governance bodies of the University, including the Board of Governors, Academic Council and other committees, as assigned.
* Assist in preparing legal notes, background documents and compliance inputs for meetings of statutory bodies.
* Support the Registrar's Office in ensuring proper documentation, follow-up and implementation of decisions/resolutions of statutory bodies.
* Assist in reviewing University policies, rules, regulations and procedures to ensure consistency with applicable laws and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain appropriate records relating to statutory approvals, resolutions, legal opinions and governance-related matters.

**Student, Faculty & Staff Related Legal Matters:**

* Provide legal and compliance support in matters relating to student discipline, grievances, academic integrity and other student-related issues.
* Support HR in matters relating to employment contracts, service rules, disciplinary proceedings and applicable labour/employment laws.
* Assist in reviewing service agreements, consultancy arrangements and other employment-related documentation.
* Support the handling of information disclosure, RTI-related matters, data privacy and other confidentiality-related requirements, as applicable.
* Ensure that appropriate legal and procedural safeguards are considered while dealing with sensitive institutional matters.

* Support the development and implementation of compliance mechanisms, checklists and standard operating procedures.
* Liaise with external lawyers, legal consultants, government departments, regulatory authorities and other relevant stakeholders.
* Coordinate with internal departments for resolution of legal and compliance issues and ensure timely closure of identified matters.
* Support internal audits, reviews and investigations relating to legal, regulatory and compliance matters.
* Maintain appropriate records and reports on the status of legal, regulatory and compliance matters.

**General Responsibilities:**

* Maintain high standards of accuracy, documentation and professional integrity in all legal and compliance-related work.
* Perform any other duties and responsibilities assigned by the Registrar from time to time.

**Educational Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in law (LL.B.) from a recognised university/institution.
* LL.M. or an additional qualification in Corporate Law, Education Law, Compliance or a related area will be an advantage.
* Enrolment with the Bar Council is preferred.

**Experience:**

* Minimum 5–8 years of relevant post-qualification experience in legal, regulatory, compliance or university administration roles.
* Experience in a higher education institution, university, educational trust, statutory body or large organisation with significant regulatory exposure will be preferred.
* Experience in drafting and reviewing contracts, MoUs and other legal documents is essential.
* Experience in handling legal notices, disputes and coordination with external legal counsel is desirable.
* Experience in dealing with UGC, AICTE, State higher education authorities or other regulatory/statutory bodies will be an advantage.
* Experience in university governance, statutory bodies, policy development and regulatory compliance will be preferred.

SymphonyAI is seeking a Functional Consultant specialising in sanctions, PEP and adverse media screening, transaction monitoring, and broader financial crime compliance. This is a dual-mandate role: trusted advisor to financial institutions on regulatory obligations, risk appetite, and operating model — and hands-on practitioner who personally configures, tunes, and optimises SymphonyAI solutions on live project engagements.
  
  
This is not an advisory-only position. A significant portion of time is spent in the product: calibrating thresholds, optimising matching logic, and reducing false positives — alongside leading workshops, shaping solution designs, and challenging client thinking with an AI-first mindset.

* Personally configure, tune, and optimise SymphonyAI screening and financial crime solutions on client projects: threshold calibration, matching logic, segmentation, list management, and false-positive reduction.
* Design and run testing and validation exercises that demonstrably improve detection quality and operational efficiency; analyse system performance and alert outcomes to drive improvements.
* Deliver implementation workstreams end to end: process design, configuration, controls testing, and user training.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to feed field insight into product innovation.

**Client Advisory & Consulting**

* Run workshops and discovery sessions to gather requirements, define use cases, and align solutions to client priorities, risk appetite, and regulatory obligations.
* Translate requirements into functional solution designs, workflows, and implementation recommendations; conduct gap analyses and remediation roadmaps.
* Act as a trusted advisor across client Compliance, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams — challenging existing methodologies to drive better outcomes.
* Advise customers on applying predictive AI, generative AI, and automation to improve screening accuracy, reduce false positives, and lift investigator productivity.

**Practice Development**

* Contribute to the Financial Crime Compliance Centre of Excellence: tuning methodologies, playbooks, and accelerators.
* Produce high-quality functional documentation, tuning reports, and implementation guidance; mentor junior consultants.

**Requirements**
**Must-Have**

* Demonstrable hands-on experience configuring, tuning, calibrating, and optimising financial crime or screening solutions — candidates must evidence tuning work personally executed, not overseen.
* 8+ years in financial crime compliance, sanctions, AML/KYC, or screening — in financial institutions, RegTech vendors, or professional services.
* Deep knowledge of end-to-end financial crime processes (onboarding, KYC/KYB, CDD/EDD, screening, monitoring, investigations, SAR/STR) and of typologies, evasion techniques, and detection methodologies.
* Strong working knowledge of global regulatory frameworks (e.g. FATF, FCA, FinCEN, EU AMLD/AMLR, CBUAE) and of screening data providers such as World-Check (LSEG) and Dow Jones.
* Strong consulting presence: proven experience running workshops and engaging senior compliance, risk, operations, and technology stakeholders up to C-suite; excellent communication and facilitation skills.
* Proficiency with SQL and data analysis for tuning and compliance insight (e.g. Power BI, Alteryx, or equivalent).

**Preferred**

* Experience with screening/monitoring platforms such as SymphonyAI NetReveal, Fircosoft, SAS, or equivalent; exposure to AI-enabled compliance technologies.
* Professional certifications: CAMS, CAMI, or ICA/MOET AML/CFT.
* Cloud SaaS implementation experience; exposure to transaction monitoring model tuning or fraud detection.
* Background in RegTech, Big 4 / specialised compliance consulting, or financial crime transformation programmes.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Delivery: on-time, on-scope, on-budget engagements; billable utilisation ≥ 80%.
* Tuning outcomes: measurable improvements in detection effectiveness and false-positive reduction.

**Reporting Line**

* Collaborates with: Product, Engineering, Data Science, Delivery Operations, Sales, and offshore delivery partners. May lead junior consultants on projects.

**About Us**
**What SymphonyAI Offers**

* Tier-1 global financial institutions, transformational screening programmes, and genuine hands-on ownership of tuning outcomes on a market-leading AI SaaS platform.
* A role in building the Financial Crime Compliance Centre of Excellence, with global exposure across EMEA, Americas, and APAC, hybrid flexibility, and competitive compensation.

**About The Role**
Our livelihoods program works with nano-entrepreneurs—small shop owners, street vendors, home-based producers, and a growing number of rural nano-entrepreneurs, many of them women. They run on thin margins, with patchy networks and limited digital literacy, and rarely operate in English.
  
  
Field operatives, Monitoring & Evaluation (M&E), and program and operations teams all need technology, and today those needs reach the tech team as separate requests. We are looking for a
**Senior Product Manager**
to set the product vision and turn these needs into one unified roadmap, grounded in time spent in the field. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Head of Technology.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
**Vision and Strategy**

* Set a 2–3 year product vision for how technology and AI can help our livelihoods program reach more nano-entrepreneurs and make field operatives more effective.
* Own the product roadmap, combining field, M&E, and operational requirements.
* Prioritize with evidence (impact on nano-entrepreneurs, effort, cost, risk) and be clear about what we won't build.
* Identify where AI meaningfully helps, and where it doesn't.

**Field Discovery**

* Spend about 20% of your time with field operatives and nano-entrepreneurs in rural and urban locations.
* Run user research and quick prototypes with low-literacy, multilingual users.

**Delivery and Outcomes**

* Write requirements engineers can build from; make scope, sequencing, and build-or-buy calls with them.
* Plan pilots and rollouts with field teams, designing for multiple languages, voice, and low-end Android devices.
* Define success metrics, track adoption and outcomes, and work with M&E on impact measurement.
* Ensure products respect privacy and consent, including India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act.

**Stakeholders**

* Bridge program, field, M&E, operations, fundraising, and technology teams, and communicate the roadmap to leadership, funders, and partners.

**Skills and Experience**
**Essential**

* 8–10 years of overall experience, with at least 2–3 years in product management owning a product from discovery to launch.
* Bachelor's degree; an MBA or Master's is a plus.
* Experience in the service or social sector, ideally in livelihoods, financial inclusion, MSME, or rural development.
* Strategic thinking: able to set a product vision and connect it to organizational goals.
* Enough technical depth to build a technology roadmap and hold your own with engineers on APIs, data, mobile, web, and cloud.
* Working knowledge of AI and LLM-based products, including evaluation and cost.
* Data-driven: comfortable with metrics, dashboards, and basic SQL or analytics tools.
* Speaks and works in at least one of Kannada, Hindi, Tamil, or Marathi, along with English, with empathy for multilingual and voice-first users.
* Able to travel about 20% of the time.
* Clear communicator who partners well with field teams, engineers, leadership, and funders.

**Nice to Have**

* Built for low-bandwidth, offline-first, or low-end Android contexts in India.
* Experience with WhatsApp, chatbot, or voice interfaces, or field data tools like KoboToolbox or ODK.

**Mindsets We're Looking For**

jobs.title: FirstClub - Senior Product Manager - Supply Chain Domain
jobs.description:
**About FirstClub**
At FirstClub, we are building a new kind of quick commerce from the ground up, and the supply chain is where that promise is won or lost.
  
  
The Supply Chain Product team builds the systems that decide what we buy, where it sits, how it moves and what we promise each member.
  
  
Every order that reaches a member on time, fresh and complete is the output of our products.
  
  
**The Team's Charter Spans The Full Supply Chain**

* Buying & Sourcing : demand-led purchase planning, vendor management, PO lifecycle and inbound scheduling.
* Collection Centers : first-mile intake, quality checks, grading and consolidation of fresh and farm produce.
* Distribution Centers (DCs) : inbound, putaway, storage, picking, packing, outbound and returns.
* Middle Mile : DC-to-Club House replenishment, trip planning, vehicle utilization and inventory movement.
* Club Houses : receiving, storage, pick-pack, cycle counts, freshness and wastage control.
* Inventory Management : single source of truth for stock, ageing and expiry, replenishment and inventory accuracy across nodes.
* Capacity Management : labor, slot, storage and throughput planning across nodes and time of day.
* Promise Engine : what we promise each member - availability and delivery ETA - based on live inventory and capacity.

**Why FirstClub**

* Build, don't babysit : Much of our supply chain stack is being built right now. You will design core systems, not just tune someone else's.
* Small team, big surface area : You'll own outcomes that would sit with a whole team at a larger company.
* Fast loops : Ship on Monday, watch it run on a Club House floor by Wednesday, improve it by Friday.
* Ground truth over slide decks : Our PMs spend real time in DCs, Collection Centers and Club Houses, not just in dashboards.
* Scrappy beats perfect : We'd rather run a pilot this week than polish a plan for next quarter.
* Your fingerprints on the company : The decisions you make now shape how FirstClub scales to every new city.

**The Role**
As a Senior Product Manager, you will own the end-to-end supply chain product charter at FirstClub - from how we source and buy, through Collection Centers, DCs and the middle mile, to inventory in our Club Houses and the promise we make each member.
  
  
Your mandate is to build a high-control, intelligent and scalable supply chain that improves availability, freshness and speed while driving down cost per order and wastage.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own the product vision, strategy and roadmap across Buying & Sourcing, Collection Centers, DCs, Middle Mile, Club Houses, Inventory Management, Capacity Management and the Promise Engine.
* Set and own the north-star metrics for the charter : availability and fill rate, promise adherence, inventory accuracy, days of inventory, wastage and shrinkage, cost per order and throughput per node.
* Partner deeply with Supply Chain, Category, Operations and Finance leadership to find the biggest ground-level problems and convert them into a prioritised, outcome-driven roadmap.
* Architect the core systems with Engineering : a single source of truth for inventory across nodes, a demand-led buying and replenishment engine, and a Promise Engine that balances availability, capacity and speed in real time.
* Build capacity planning across labour, slots, storage and vehicles, so the network flexes for peaks, new categories and new cities.
* Own the frontline tooling strategy for associates, site managers, QC teams and transport partners - making work simpler, faster and measurable, including productivity tracking and incentives.
* Lead build-vs-buy decisions across WMS, TMS, procurement and planning systems, and drive integrations with vendors and 3P partners.
* Treat AI and automation as first principles, not add-ons : forecasting, auto-replenishment, intelligent allocation, anomaly and shrinkage detection, and agentic workflows that remove manual decisions from planners and site teams.
* Run a strong experimentation and measurement culture - pilots by node or city, clear success criteria, and rigorous readouts.
* Lead, coach and grow a team of Product Managers, raising the bar on problem framing, execution, stakeholder management and ground-level empathy.
* Help shape the operating model for scaling FirstClub's supply chain across cities with high reliability and healthy unit economics.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 5 - 8 years of Product Management experience, with a track record of owning and scaling products with measurable business impact.
* Experience leading or mentoring Product Managers, and happy to be a player-coach who still owns hands-on product work.
* Deep experience in supply chain, warehousing, quick commerce, e-commerce, grocery, food delivery or logistics, ideally across more than one node of the chain.
* Strong understanding of inventory planning, replenishment, warehouse operations, middle-mile logistics, capacity planning or delivery promise systems.
* Experience building products with a significant frontline or ground operations component.
* Proven ability to move operational and financial metrics such as fill rate, wastage, cost per order, productivity and SLA adherence.
* Strong analytical depth : comfortable with SQL, experimentation and working alongside Data Science on forecasting and optimisation problems.
* An AI-native mindset : you think naturally about how ML, automation and agents can change how decisions get made, not just how screens look.
* Excellent stakeholder management with senior Operations, Category, Finance and Engineering leaders.
* You thrive in early-stage, fast-moving environments : you'll write the spec, pull the data and walk the floor yourself, and you know the answer is usually a mix of technology, process and operational change.
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, Business, Economics or a related field.
* An MBA is a plus; strong product experience matters more.

**Good To Have**

* Built or scaled a WMS, inventory platform, procurement system, TMS or promise/ETA engine.
* Experience with fresh, perishable and cold-chain supply chains, including FEFO, grading and expiry management.
* Exposure to demand forecasting, replenishment optimization, slotting, network planning or routing.
* Experience launching and scaling operations across multiple cities and high daily order volumes.
* Experience building frontline workforce products : productivity tracking, incentives, gamification or training.
* Experience shipping AI/ML-driven decisioning or agentic workflows in production operations.

Job Description: Data Scientist – Machine Learning & Optimization

**Experience:**
4–6 Years

**Location:**
Bangalore

**Work Mode:**
Hybrid

About CoffeeBeans Consulting

CoffeeBeans is a fast-growing technology company delivering high-quality software, data engineering, and AI solutions to clients across industries. We combine deep technical expertise with an agile mindset to solve complex business problems. Our teams work at the intersection of Data Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build intelligent, scalable, and business-focused solutions.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Data Scientist with strong expertise in Python, Machine Learning, Time-Series Modelling, and Numerical Optimization. The ideal candidate should have experience working with industrial or process-related data and developing predictive models to improve operational efficiency and optimize manufacturing processes.

The role involves reviewing and enhancing existing ML models, developing predictive solutions using historical and real-time industrial data, and applying constrained optimization techniques to identify optimal operating parameters. The candidate will also work closely with process engineers, plant operators, and domain experts to translate operational challenges into data-driven solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, evaluate, and improve Machine Learning models using Python for industrial and process-related applications.
* Work with algorithms such as LightGBM and Generalized Additive Models (GAM) for predictive modelling.
* Perform feature engineering, model validation, diagnostics, and explainability to improve model performance.
* Analyse time-series data, historical process data, sensor readings, equipment performance data, and laboratory data to build predictive models.
* Develop forecasting and predictive solutions using lagged features, process variables, and operational parameters.
* Apply numerical and constrained optimization techniques to identify optimal operating conditions.
* Work on multi-objective optimization problems involving throughput, recovery, production efficiency, and operational costs.
* Perform sensitivity analysis and scenario modelling to evaluate the impact of different operating parameters.
* Build and maintain ML pipelines, model inference workflows, and deployment processes.
* Perform live model validation and shadow testing by comparing model predictions against actual plant outcomes.
* Implement model monitoring and feedback mechanisms to ensure model reliability and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with process engineers, plant operators, and operational SMEs to understand business requirements and deliver practical solutions.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 4–6 years of hands-on experience in Python programming and Machine Learning.
* Strong experience in developing and improving ML models.
* Hands-on experience with LightGBM and Generalized Additive Models (GAM).
* Strong understanding of feature engineering, model validation, diagnostics, and model explainability.
* Experience in Time-Series Modelling, forecasting, and predictive analytics.
* Experience working with industrial process data, sensor data, historian data, or equipment performance data.
* Knowledge of numerical optimization, constrained optimization, and multi-objective optimization techniques.
* Experience with operating parameter optimization, sensitivity analysis, or scenario modelling.
* Understanding of ML pipelines, model deployment, inference workflows, and model monitoring.

Good to Have

* Experience in manufacturing, metals, mining, cement, chemicals, petrochemicals, oil & gas, power, or other process industries.
* Experience in manufacturing optimization, industrial process optimization, or production efficiency improvement.
* Familiarity with metaheuristic algorithms and optimization techniques.
* Experience with Kedro (QuantumBlack) or similar ML pipeline frameworks.
* Experience with API integration, live model testing, and shadow deployment.
* Experience working closely with process engineers, plant operators, and industrial domain experts.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who can combine strong Machine Learning fundamentals with practical industrial problem-solving skills. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with complex, time-dependent industrial datasets, improving existing predictive models, and applying optimization techniques to solve real-world manufacturing and operational challenges.

jobs.description:
Job Purpose and Impact
  
  

* The Full Stack Developer – Corporate Risk Reporting role focuses on the risk visualization layer of the Corporate Risk Reporting (CRR) platform. The role is responsible for building application capabilities that enable fast, flexible, and intuitive consumption of enterprise risk data for internal risk management users.
* Within the CRR architecture, core risk logic is implemented in PostgreSQL, with curated risk results published into OpenSearch to support high-performance reporting, fuzzy filtering, and interactive exploration. This role remains hands-on in building solutions using .NET-based backend services and React-based frontend applications, while also leading and coaching junior full stack developers to deliver cohesive, high-quality visualization capabilities.
* The position plays a key role in translating complex risk datasets into scalable and user-friendly reporting experiences, while setting technical direction and standards for the CRR visualization layer.

Key Accountabilities
  
  
**RISK VISUALIZATION DELIVERY:**
Designs and implements user-facing risk reporting capabilities that enable efficient visualization and exploration of enterprise risk data, including positions, P&L, FX exposures, and entering adjustments.
  
  
**FRONTEND EXPERIENCE DELIVERY:**
Development of high-performance and intuitive user interfaces using React and AgGrid, optimized for large datasets and advanced interaction patterns such as drilldowns, pivots, filtering, and navigation.
  
  
**BACKEND SERVICES AND APIs:**
Develops .NET-based backend services that mediate access to OpenSearch, support aggregation and query orchestration, and enable consistent data consumption patterns.
  
  
**OPENSEARCH CONSUMPTION:**
Implements effective OpenSearch query, indexing and consumption patterns to support fast retrieval, fuzzy filtering, and flexible exploration of risk data published from PostgreSQL.
  
  
**ENGINEERING QUALITY:**
Enforces engineering standards for the visualization layer, including code quality, testing practices, and CI/CD adoption, ensuring maintainable and reliable solutions.
  
  
**PERFORMANCE AND USABILITY:**
Owns performance and usability outcomes for the visualization layer, actively identifying and addressing bottlenecks across frontend, backend, and OpenSearch interactions.
  
  
**COLLABORATION:**
Works closely with the CRR Development Lead and Senior Business Analyst to align visualization capabilities with platform architecture and business risk requirements.
  
  
**CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT:**
Continuously evaluates and improves visualization patterns, technical approaches, and team practices to enhance the effectiveness and scalability of CRR risk reporting.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Minimum requirement of 3 years of relevant work experience, typically reflecting 5+ years in delivering full-stack applications in data-intensive or analytics-driven environments.
  
  
Demonstrated experience delivery of user-facing reporting or analytics solutions, with proven ability to guide and mentor other engineers.
  
  
**Required Skills:**
**Mandatory:**

* Strong experience developing backend services using .NET
* Strong experience building frontend applications using React
* Hands-on experience with AgGrid for large, data-intensive reporting views
* Exposure to cloud-native deployment models and CI/CD pipelines

**Good to Have:**

* Experience working with risk, finance, or trading reporting platforms
* Experience consuming and querying OpenSearch for fast, flexible reporting and fuzzy filtering
* Familiarity with PostgreSQL-backed data solutions
* Experience coaching or mentoring engineers in a delivery-focused environment

jobs.description:
**About Us**
We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead.
  
  
Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!
  
  
**Overview**
The Product Manager owns the entire product lifecycle, from conceptualization to obsolescence, defining what to build by translating market and customer needs into solutions that deliver profitable growth and competitive differentiation. This role is responsible for developing product roadmaps, managing product P&L, and ensuring alignment with customer needs and market opportunities. The Product Manager partners cross-functionally to deliver and maintain innovative, high-impact products that meet business objectives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute 5-year product roadmaps, managing the product lifecycle from development to obsolescence
* Set product priorities for new developments and manage product P&L to optimize margins
* Create comprehensive business cases outlining expected returns
* Define product positioning and ensure designs meet customer use cases
* Owns and accurately maintains product information throughout the lifecycle
* Gather and analyze Voice of Customer insights to inform product features and functionality
* Translate market and customer insights into clear product requirements, features, and technical direction
* Balance growth, cost, and profitability through disciplined product portfolio and lifecycle management
* Own product data integrity and structure, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and alignment with global data standards to enable effective commercialization, analytics, and digital tools
* Support pricing strategy and execution by providing product inputs (e.g., cost, features, value drivers) and partnering with Pricing to enable value-based pricing, margin optimization, and competitive positioning
* Develop and support sales enablement tools (e.g., product documentation, technical collateral, value drivers) to ensure accurate representation of product capabilities and effective customer engagement
* Partner cross-functionally (engineering, operations, commercial) to ensure successful delivery and adoption
* Continuously refine products based on performance, feedback, and evolving customer needs

**KPIs**

* Revenue and profitability by product line
* Market share growth vs. competitors
* ROI on new product development
* Roadmap execution (on-time, in-scope delivery)
* Customer satisfaction and product adoption

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum five years of experience in product management, product development, or a related field.
* Proven leadership and communication skills with success in aligning cross-functional teams to deliver product roadmaps and achieve revenue goals.
* Advanced proficiency with product lifecycle management tools, data analysis platforms, and performance tracking systems.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills rooted in data-driven decision-making and customer-centric product development.
* A relentless pursuit of excellence and a strong desire to build innovative products that deliver profitable growth and competitive differentiation.
* Deep commitment to ownership, continuous learning, and taking proactive steps to improve product outcomes.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, engineering, marketing, or a related field.
* Advanced knowledge of product positioning, pricing strategies, and P&L management.
* Experience in developing business cases, ROI analysis, and product roadmaps.
* Deep understanding of Voice of Customer (VoC) insights, translating into product requirements.
* Familiarity with agile development methodologies and tools.

**Our Commitment to Our People**
Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial.
  
  
Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal - to make the world a better place. We invest in the end-to-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally.
  
  
Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.
  
  
Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team!

Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland.

jobs.description:
Job Description | Mosaic Wellness Pvt. Ltd. | Research & Development
  
  
**Role at a glance**
Mosaic Wellness is hiring an Assistant Manager to own gummy and nutraceutical development, from bench formulation to commercial launch.
  
  
**Position**
Assistant Manager – Gummies & Nutraceuticals
**Function**
Research & Development (New Product Development)
**Location**
Thane West, Mumbai
**Reports to**
Head of R&D
**Experience**
6–10 years in nutraceutical R&D, including hands-on gummy development
**Education**
M.Sc. (Science) or M.Tech in a relevant discipline
**Travel**
Regular visits to CDMO and supplier sites across India
**Employment**
Full-time
  
  
**About Mosaic Wellness**
Mosaic Wellness is a Mumbai-based, digital-first health and wellness company. Its consumer brands, including Man Matters, Be Bodywise and Little Joys, serve men’s, women’s and children’s health and nutrition needs.
  
  
Our R&D team develops science-led nutraceuticals, functional foods and personal care products with manufacturing partners across India. Gummies are a key format across the portfolio.
  
  
**Role purpose**
You will own gummy and nutraceutical products end to end: formulation on the bench, scale-up at CDMOs, and a stable, compliant commercial launch.
  
  
The role solves the hard problems of the gummy format: high active loads, taste masking, sugar reduction, texture and shelf-life stability. You will be R&D’s point person for this category across brands, working closely with Brand, Quality, Regulatory, Procurement and manufacturing partners.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Formulation and product development**

* Develop gummies across gelling systems (gelatin, pectin, carrageenan, agar, starch), including vegan, sugar-free and reduced-sugar variants.
* Formulate with demanding actives: vitamins, minerals, botanicals, probiotics, prebiotic fibres and other high-load ingredients.
* Engineer taste and texture through bitterness masking, flavour and acid profiling, chew optimisation, colour stability, sanding and oil coating.
* Design out gummy failure modes: sweating, stickiness, crystallisation, syneresis, heat deformation, browning and active degradation.
* Extend expertise to other formats as needed: powders and sachets, tablets, capsules, effervescents and chewables.

Mosaic Wellness Pvt. Ltd. | Page of
  
  

* Run bench trials, Design of Experiments (DoE) and sensory evaluations, with complete lab records.

**Process development, scale-up and tech transfer**

* Define critical process parameters: cook temperature and solids (°Brix), deposit pH and temperature, deposit weight, curing conditions and final water activity.
* Lead pilot, scale-up and first commercial batches on starch mogul and starchless depositing lines at CDMO sites.
* Prepare tech-transfer packages: formula, bill of materials, process flow, Master Formula Record inputs and specifications.
* Troubleshoot weight variation, tailing, mould sticking and yield loss to deliver right-first-time commercialisation.

**Stability, quality and analytics**

* Design accelerated and real-time stability studies under ICH-aligned conditions (including Zone IVb, 30 °C/75% RH) to set overages and shelf life.
* Write raw material, packaging and finished-goods specifications; review analytical data with in-house teams and NABL-accredited labs.
* Select packaging for moisture and oxygen protection, backed by water-activity and moisture-sorption data.
* Lead root-cause analysis and CAPA for deviations, out-of-specification results and consumer complaints.

**Regulatory and documentation**

* Keep formulations and labels compliant with FSSAI’s Health Supplements and Nutraceuticals Regulations (2022), Labelling and Display Regulations (2020) and AYUSH norms where relevant.
* Check ingredient permissibility, RDA-based limits and label claims; prepare technical dossiers, including for Non-Specified Food approvals.
* Support export-market requirements (e.g., GCC, US 21 CFR) with Regulatory Affairs.

**Ingredients, partners and cost**

* Scout and qualify new ingredients, technologies and suppliers, and develop alternate sources for supply resilience.
* Assess CDMO capability and build strong technical partnerships with manufacturing and ingredient partners.
* Hit COGS targets through formulation and process value engineering, without compromising efficacy or sensory quality.

**Collaboration and team**

* Translate brand and consumer briefs into technical briefs, and deliver launches on the NPD calendar with cross-functional teams.
* Guide and mentor junior scientists, and share learnings across R&D.
* Track global gummy and delivery-format trends, and contribute to patents and scientific publications.

**What We’re Looking For**
**Education**
**One Of The Following**

* M.Sc. in Food Science and Technology, Food and Nutrition, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biotechnology or Pharmaceutical Sciences
* M.Tech in Food Technology, Food Engineering, Chemical Engineering or Pharmaceutical Technology

Mosaic Wellness Pvt. Ltd. | Page of
  
  
**Experience**

* 6–10 years in R&D or NPD for nutraceuticals, health supplements or functional foods, at a consumer brand, nutraceutical company or CDMO.
* At least 3 years of hands-on gummy development, with products taken from concept to commercial launch.
* Scale-up experience on mogul or starchless depositing lines, in-house or at a CDMO.
* A track record of stability-led formulation, setting overages and shelf life for vitamins, botanicals or probiotics.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong grasp of hydrocolloid and sugar/polyol science: gelation, pH and calcium sensitivity, glass transition, crystallisation and water activity.
* Confident with analytical data: assay and HPLC results, moisture and water activity, texture analysis and microbiology.
* Working knowledge of FSSAI nutraceutical and labelling regulations, GMP and HACCP.
* Structured experimentation (DoE), clear technical documentation and crisp reporting.
* Able to run several projects, CDMOs and stakeholders in parallel.

**Good to have**

* Experience with tablets, capsules, softgels, powders or effervescents alongside gummies.
* Probiotic, high-fibre, high-load or centre-filled gummy development.
* Work with microencapsulated actives or other novel delivery formats.
* Exposure to export regulations: US 21 CFR 111, GCC (GSO) or EU.
* Experience in a D2C or fast-growing consumer health company.
* Patents or peer-reviewed publications.
* Statistical tools such as Minitab, JMP or Design-Expert.

**What Success Looks Like In The First 12 Months**
Within a year, gummies are a dependable, scalable platform for Mosaic’s brands.
  
  

* Gummy and nutraceutical launches delivered on the NPD calendar, scaled up right first time at CDMOs.
* Every launched SKU meets label claim through shelf life, backed by robust stability data.
* Measurable COGS savings from value engineering on existing products.
* A stronger gummy platform: documented process windows, qualified alternate suppliers and fewer quality complaints.

**Why join**
You get real ownership, scientific depth and room to grow.
  
  

* Own a key format end to end, with direct influence on what reaches consumers.
* Work in a lean, decentralised R&D team where scientists own their projects and decisions sit close to the bench.
* Grow beyond gummies into nutraceuticals, functional foods and novel delivery technologies.
* Build your scientific profile through patents and publications, alongside leaders with deep global CPG experience.

How to Apply

* Visit our careers page: counton.ai/careers/chief-of-staff-operations and apply for faster response

The role

R&D, service, production and sales at CountAI all move fast — and the most important work stalls between them. You run the company's daily execution rhythm: every morning you know what matters most, who owns it and what is blocking it. You clear blocks before they cost us a customer date, and you give top management one honest picture of where things stand and who is delivering. You work directly with the CEO and leadership to get the top-priority work done.

What you will do

* Run the morning meeting every day in 20 minutes or less: understand how each team's tasks flow and set their order of importance, so everyone works on what matters most.
* Keep one company priority list with owners, dates and dependencies. When priorities clash between teams, settle it — or take it to leadership the same day.
* Make sure no task is blocked anywhere in operations — R&D, service, production, purchase or sales. Find the block, name the owner, follow up until it is cleared.
* Track delivery by person — who commits, who delivers on time, and where people need help — and share it fairly with their managers as a monthly view.
* Give management a weekly overview: what moved, what slipped and why, the risks coming up, and the decisions needed.
* Turn leadership decisions into tracked actions, and close every loop.
* Build the tracking system itself — sheets, Jira or ClickUp, and AI tools — so it runs without chasing by email.

* You have run daily or weekly review meetings with team leads — and people respected the follow-up.
* You understand both how a factory runs and how R&D works; you can tell an engineering delay from a purchase delay.
* Firm and fair: you can tell a senior engineer their task is late and still have their trust tomorrow.

OB DESCRIPTIONProject Manager – Nutraceutical Industry

**Company:** Sunshine Corporation (Brand: NoCheat) – Jolly Group of Companies  
**Location:** Rajkot, Gujarat  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | On-Site  
**Department:** Nutraceutical / FMCG  
**Experience:** 5+ Years Preferred  
**Salary:** No Bar for the Right Candidate  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Preferred

About the Company

Jolly Group of Companies is a diversified business group operating across multiple sectors, including textiles, real estate, oil recycling, insurance, FMCG, and nutraceuticals.

Under our brand **NoCheat**, we are expanding our nutraceutical business with innovative health, wellness, sports nutrition, beauty nutrition, and kids' nutrition products.

We are looking for an experienced **Nutraceutical Project Manager** to lead and manage product development projects from concept to successful commercial launch.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Project Planning & Management**

* Plan, execute, and monitor nutraceutical product development projects.
* Manage project timelines, budgets, resources, and deliverables.
* Coordinate multiple product launches simultaneously.
* Ensure timely completion of projects.

**2. Product Development & R&D Coordination**

* Work closely with R&D teams on product formulations and development.
* Coordinate development of powders, gummies, liquids, premixes, and other nutraceutical products.
* Oversee product trials, sampling, stability testing, and formulation approvals.
* Ensure product quality, effectiveness, and market suitability.

**3. Manufacturing & Vendor Management**

* Coordinate with third-party manufacturers and contract manufacturing partners.
* Manage vendor selection, raw material sourcing, and packaging development.
* Monitor production schedules, manufacturing trials, and commercial batches.
* Ensure manufacturing quality and timely product delivery.

**4. Regulatory Compliance & Quality Assurance**

* Ensure products comply with applicable FSSAI regulations and other relevant standards.
* Coordinate product documentation, testing, certifications, and label approvals.
* Work with QA/QC teams to maintain product quality and safety.
* Ensure proper regulatory documentation before product launch.

**5. Product Launch & Commercialization**

* Manage end-to-end product commercialization.
* Coordinate with marketing, branding, packaging, purchase, and sales teams.
* Monitor packaging development, costing, and production readiness.
* Ensure successful product launches within approved timelines.

**6. Budget & Cost Management**

* Prepare and monitor project budgets.
* Control formulation, manufacturing, packaging, and development costs.
* Negotiate with suppliers and manufacturing partners.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising quality.

**7. Team Management & Reporting**

* Lead cross-functional teams, including R&D, Purchase, QA/QC, Production, and Marketing.
* Conduct regular project review meetings.
* Prepare project progress reports for senior management and the Managing Director.
* Identify project risks and implement corrective actions.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Pharmacy, Food Technology, Nutraceutical Science, Biotechnology, Chemistry, or a related field.

* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in nutraceuticals, dietary supplements, health supplements, or FMCG product development.
* Experience handling multiple product development and launch projects.
* Strong understanding of formulation development, manufacturing processes, and regulatory compliance.
* Experience working with third-party manufacturers.

Key Skills

* Project Management & Execution
* Nutraceutical Product Development

* Vendor & Supplier Management
* Product Launch Management
* Budgeting & Cost Optimization
* Leadership & Team Coordination
* Problem-Solving & Decision-Making

We are looking for a result-oriented professional who can independently manage nutraceutical projects from **product concept, formulation, sampling, testing, manufacturing, and packaging to final market launch**.

Candidates with experience in sports nutrition, kids' nutrition, beauty nutrition, and daily health supplements will be preferred.

Inside Sales Executive – FMCG / Food & Beverage

**Location:** Taramani Chennai  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Industry:** FMCG / Food & Beverage / Food Processing / Nutraceuticals / Consumer Products

**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive and target-oriented **Inside Sales Executive** to generate business opportunities, engage prospective clients and support revenue growth through outbound calls, email campaigns, LinkedIn outreach and inbound enquiry management.

The candidate will be responsible for identifying potential customers across the FMCG, food and beverage, nutraceutical, food processing and consumer products industries and introducing them to our company's services.

The role involves understanding customer requirements, explaining our service offerings, qualifying leads, scheduling meetings and nurturing prospects throughout the sales cycle.

The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, confidence in making outbound calls, strong follow-up abilities and an interest in the food, FMCG and consumer products industry.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Inside Sales & Lead Conversion**

* Handle inbound business enquiries received through the company website, email, LinkedIn and other marketing channels.
* Conduct outbound calls to prospective B2B clients.
* Introduce company services and identify potential business opportunities.
* Explain services related to food product development, formulation, R&D, pilot manufacturing, contract manufacturing and commercialization.
* Understand customer requirements and identify suitable service offerings.
* Convert enquiries into qualified sales opportunities.
* Nurture prospects through regular calls, emails and follow-ups.
* Work towards achieving monthly sales and conversion targets.

**2. Lead Generation & Prospecting**

* Generate qualified B2B leads through cold calling, LinkedIn, email outreach, company databases and online research.
* Identify potential customers in the FMCG, food and beverage, nutraceutical and food processing industries.

**3. Client Communication & Follow-ups**

* Understand customer requirements related to new product development, food formulation, product improvement and manufacturing.
* Follow up with prospects regarding enquiries, proposals, quotations and ongoing discussions.

Develop a good understanding of the company's service portfolio, including:

* Food R&D and innovation.

* Nutraceutical and health product development.
* Pilot-scale product development.
* Contract manufacturing and private-label solutions.
* Food testing and quality-related services.
* Food regulatory and compliance support.

The candidate should be able to communicate the basic value proposition of these services and coordinate with technical teams for detailed discussions.

**5. Sales Coordination & Proposal Support**

* Coordinate with business development, R&D, formulation and technical teams.
* Understand client project requirements and communicate them internally.

* Schedule technical discussions and client meetings.
* Follow up on proposals and quotations to move prospects towards conversion.
* Maintain communication with clients throughout the sales process.
* Support smooth client onboarding after successful conversion.

**6. CRM & Sales Reporting**

* Maintain accurate records of leads, calls, emails, follow-ups and sales opportunities.
* Update CRM systems with prospect details and communication history.
* Track lead status, enquiry sources, meeting schedules and conversions.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly sales activity reports.
* Monitor call performance, lead qualification and conversion rates.
* Maintain a structured follow-up schedule.
* Share regular sales updates with the reporting manager.

**Target Client Segments**

The candidate will engage with prospective clients from:

* FMCG companies and consumer brands.
* Food and beverage manufacturers.
* Packaged food companies.
* Beverage and functional drink brands.
* Dairy and dairy-based product manufacturers.
* Snacks, bakery and confectionery companies.
* Ready-to-eat and ready-to-cook food brands.

* Health and wellness startups.
* Organic and plant-based food brands.
* Food processing companies.

* Food and beverage startups.

**Required Skills**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Confidence in making outbound calls and handling customer conversations.
* Strong inside sales and lead generation capabilities.
* Good telephone etiquette and professional email communication.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and qualify business leads.
* Strong persuasion, negotiation and follow-up skills.
* Ability to explain services and communicate value propositions.
* Good relationship management and customer engagement skills.
* Basic understanding of the FMCG, food and beverage or consumer products industry.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
* Familiarity with CRM software, LinkedIn and email outreach tools.
* Ability to work with sales targets and deadlines.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.

**Educational Qualification**

**Preferred:**

* MBA – Marketing / Sales / Business Development.
* BBA / BBM / B.Com.
* B.Sc / M.Sc – Food Science and Technology.
* Food Technology / Food Processing.
* Biotechnology / Microbiology.
* Nutrition and Dietetics.
* Dairy Technology.
* Any relevant business, marketing or food science qualification.

**Preferred Experience**

Experience in any of the following areas will be an advantage:

* Inside Sales / Telesales.

jobs.description:
**Service Manager Job Description**

**1. Service Management**

* Develop and implement service policies, procedures, and standards to ensure consistency and efficiency
* Lead and supervise service technicians and service coordinator.
* Allocate service calls, installations, and preventive maintenance jobs(CMC).
* Monitor daily service activities, productivity, and discipline.
* Conduct technical training, safety training, and performance reviews.
* Ensure technicians follow SOPs, safety norms, and documentation standards.

**2. ERP Management (End-to-End)**

* Collect data for raising ticket, Designation, Phone number, Email ID, Machine Model, Serial Number, Complaint Description, Photo/ Video.
* Raise quotation based on the approval/ payment conformation, allot service technician as per the availability, competency, location and criticality of service.
* Ensure **job cards are raised accurately** for all service calls from Customer, Project team, and Sales team. (installation, breakdown, PM, AMC/CMC).
* Review job card details including complaint description, parts used, labour, travel, and service status.
* Ensure service reports are attached with job card.

**3. Coordination & Service Scheduling**

* Work closely with the **Service Coordinator** to:
* Receive service requests and log complaints.
* Schedule technicians and site visits.
* Track job status and escalation.

**4. Spare Parts & Warranty Control**

* Approve spare parts usage as per warranty/AMC/chargeable conditions.
* Monitor spare consumption against job cards.
* Ensure defective parts are returned and handed over properly to concern department.
* Coordinate with stores for inventory reconciliation.

**5. Billing & Payment Coordination (PI to Payment)**

* Review & Approve the Performa invoice and ensure all commercial documentation was completed.
* Verify completed job cards for **billing eligibility** (Warranty, AMC/CMC, out-of-warranty calls).
* Ensure timely submission of approved Performa Invoice to accounts for invoicing.
* Coordinate with accounts and service coordinator to track invoices.
* Follow up with customers for payment realization and resolve service-related billing queries.
* Ensure closure of service tickets only after payment confirmation.

\*

* Act as escalation point for service-related customer issues.
* Ensure professional communication with hospitals.
* Review customer feedback and take corrective actions.

* Maintain service reports, installation certificates, and AMC logs.
* Support audits and regulatory inspections related to service operations.

* Require to share Weekly Service Call Report & Weekly Installation Report to MD.
* Analyse repeat complaints, response time, closure efficiency on Monthly Service Call Report & Monthly Installation Report.

* Identify recurring technical issues and provide feedback to R&D and production teams.
* Improve service efficiency, cost control, and customer satisfaction.

As the **world’s largest** manufacturer of motorcycles and scooters for the last **25 years**, Hero is where you will get to work with the brightest innovators, passionate about being the best in what they do. jobs.description:
**Company:** CEV Engineering  
**Department:** Service & Technical Support  
**Designation:** Assistant Manager  
**Experience:** 5–8 Years (Automotive Industry Preferred)  
**Qualification:** B.Tech / Diploma in Automobile or Mechanical Engineering  
**Job Location:** Delhi NCR / Field Operations

**1. Job Purpose**

To manage CNG vehicle field issues, provide technical support to dealers, coordinate with OEM and plant quality teams, and ensure timely resolution of customer and dealer complaints. The role will focus on improving product quality, reducing warranty claims, strengthening dealer technical capabilities, and improving service performance.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Field Issue Management**

* Handle and investigate CNG vehicle technical complaints reported by dealers and customers.
* Conduct vehicle inspections and field visits to identify root causes of technical issues.
* Analyse recurring failures and prepare detailed technical investigation reports.
* Coordinate with OEM, Plant Quality, R&D, and Production teams for corrective actions.
* Monitor complaint trends and ensure timely closure of field issues.
* Escalate critical and repetitive issues to senior management.

**B. Dealer Technical Support**

* Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support to dealer service teams.
* Plan and conduct dealer visits for technical issue resolution.
* Ensure proper CNG system inspection and repair procedures are followed.
* Support dealers in reducing unnecessary part replacement.
* Monitor dealer technical performance and identify training requirements.

**C. Warranty Management**

* Monitor CNG parts warranty claims and replacement activities.
* Analyse warranty failures and identify high-failure components.
* Coordinate with dealers for defective part return and technical investigation.
* Monitor warranty claim numbers and warranty cost.
* Work towards reducing repeat failures and unnecessary warranty claims.

**D. Technical Training & Development**

* Organise technical training for dealer technicians and service advisors.
* Develop training materials, technical manuals, and troubleshooting guides.
* Conduct practical training on CNG components and diagnostic tools.
* Evaluate dealer technicians' technical knowledge and capabilities.

**E. Reporting & Documentation**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly field issue reports.
* Maintain a technical complaint database and track issue closure.
* Prepare 8D reports, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and Corrective Action Reports.
* Monitor KPIs related to field complaints, warranty claims, and dealer performance.
* Present technical performance and improvement plans to management.

**F. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with OEM Quality, Service, Plant Quality, R&D, and Production teams.
* Follow up on corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Support new vehicle launches and CNG system validation activities.
* Coordinate with internal teams for spare parts availability and technical support.

**3. Required Technical Skills**

* Good knowledge of CNG vehicle systems and components.
* Knowledge of CNG regulators, injectors, pressure sensors, cylinders, HP tubes, and fittings.
* Understanding of CNG diagnostics and scanning tools.
* Knowledge of vehicle troubleshooting and failure analysis.
* Understanding of warranty processes and quality tools (5 Why, Fishbone, 8D).
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and technical reporting.

**4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Reduction in repeat field complaints.
* Reduction in warranty claims and warranty costs.
* Timely closure of field issues.
* Dealer technical support response time.
* Number of dealer technical training sessions conducted.
* Improvement in first-time-right repair performance.
* Reduction in unnecessary part replacement.
* Timely submission of RCA and corrective action reports.

**5. Competencies Required**

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Team management and leadership abilities.
* Effective communication and coordination.
* Decision-making and escalation management.
* Customer and dealer handling skills.
* Willingness to travel for field inspections and dealer support.

**6. Expected Deliverables**

* Timely resolution of CNG field issues.
* Improved dealer technical capabilities.
* Reduced warranty cost and repeat complaints.
* Effective coordination with OEM and plant teams.
* Improved CNG service quality and customer satisfaction.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

--------------------

**Position: Executive – NPD**
=============================

**New Product Development (Confectionery)**
===========================================

**Department:** Product and Technology Development (PTD)
  
**Category:** Confectionery
  
**Location:** NPD Laboratory, Greater Noida
  
**Reporting To:** Senior Manager

### **1. Job Purpose**

To support New Product Development activities in the confectionery category through hands-on laboratory work, prototype preparation, sample development, product evaluation and execution of R&D trials. The position will be primarily based in the NPD laboratory and responsible for ensuring timely preparation of quality prototypes, lab report preparation and samples as per project requirements.

### **2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Laboratory Prototype Development**

* Prepare laboratory-scale prototypes for various confectionery and its allied products as per project briefs and technical requirements.
* Execute product formulation, ingredient weighing, mixing, processing and sample preparation.
* Support the development of new product concepts, flavors, textures, shapes and variants.
* Work on product modifications and formulation adjustments based on feedback from internal stakeholders.
* Maintain consistency and reproducibility of laboratory prototypes.

**B. Sample Preparation & Management**

* Prepare product samples for internal evaluations, sensory assessments, consumer testing and customer presentations.
* Ensure proper labelling, coding, packaging and storage of prototype samples.
* Maintain sample records, formulation details and development history.
* Coordinate timely dispatch and availability of samples for different stakeholders.

**C. Laboratory Trials & Equipment Handling**

* Conduct laboratory trials using confectionery processing equipment and laboratory tools.
* Operate and maintain laboratory equipment while following established operating procedures.
* Ensure proper cleaning, sanitation and maintenance of laboratory equipment and workstations.
* Support pilot-scale and factory trials whenever required.

**D. Documentation & Data Management**

* Maintain accurate records of formulations, raw material consumption, trial observations and process parameters.
* Prepare laboratory trial reports and maintain sample tracking records.
* Update formulation sheets, trial logs and product development databases.
* Ensure proper documentation and traceability of all development activities.

**E. Raw Material & Inventory Management**

* Maintain laboratory raw material inventory and ensure availability of ingredients required for development activities.
* Monitor raw material consumption, expiry dates and storage conditions.
* Coordinate with procurement and warehouse teams for raw material requirements.
* Ensure proper handling and storage of food ingredients as per recommended conditions.

**F. Quality, Safety & Hygiene**

* Follow food safety, personal hygiene and laboratory safety practices.
* Ensure cleanliness and housekeeping of the NPD laboratory.
* Identify and report any deviations in raw material quality or laboratory processing.
* Follow established SOPs and maintain good laboratory practices.

**G. Cross-functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with NPD team members for timely execution of development projects.
* Support Marketing, Quality, Production and other stakeholders in sample preparation and product evaluation.
* Incorporate feedback from sensory evaluations and internal product reviews into subsequent prototypes.

### **3. Key Skills & Competencies**

* Hands-on experience in food product development or confectionery laboratory operations.
* Basic understanding of confectionery ingredients, formulations and processing techniques.
* Practical knowledge of weighing, mixing, heating, forming, depositing and sample preparation.
* Good observation, analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Basic computer knowledge (MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint).
* Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple sample development requirements and timelines.
* Good communication and coordination skills.

### **4. Educational Qualification**

* M.Tech in Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy Technology or related disciplines.

### **5. Experience**

* **Preferred experience:** 2–5 years in Food R&D, New Product Development or laboratory operations.
* Experience in confectionery products such as gummies, jellies, hard-boiled candies, toffees, lollipops or similar categories will be preferred.
* Freshers with strong practical knowledge and relevant academic exposure may also be considered.

### **6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely preparation and delivery of prototype samples.
* Accuracy and consistency of laboratory formulations.
* Successful execution of assigned laboratory trials.
* Accuracy and completeness of trial documentation.
* Effective management of laboratory raw materials and inventory.
* Compliance with laboratory hygiene, safety and housekeeping standards.
* Responsiveness to internal sample development requirements.

### **7. Nature of Role**

This is a hands-on, laboratory-oriented position requiring regular involvement in prototype preparation, product development experiments, sample handling and laboratory operations. The incumbent will be primarily stationed at the NPD laboratory and will support factory/pilot and factory trials as and when required.

New Product Development

Food Science

Food Technology

Lab handling

jobs.title: Manager Group Demand Planning
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

DÖHLER – WE BRING IDEAS TO LIFE.®  
Döhler is a global producer, marketer and provider of technology-driven natural ingredients, ingredient systems and integrated solutions for the global food, beverage and life science & nutrition industry. Döhler is all about mastering sensory experience and nutritional performance. Being sustainable by nature, Döhler helps to nourish the world better: Good for people – Good for planet.

 **Job Description**

The Data Scientist – Demand Planning & Supply Chain Analytics (m/f/d) is part of the Demand Planning function within Global Business Services (GBS) and is responsible for developing and improving data-driven forecasting, planning, and decision-support solutions for the assigned portfolio.  
The role combines advanced analytics, statistical modelling, and machine learning with business understanding to improve forecast accuracy, supply chain visibility, service levels, inventory performance, and planning efficiency — with particular focus on continuously improving the statistical (base) demand forecast that underpins Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP/IBP).  
The position acts as a bridge between Sales, Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Finance, IT, and business stakeholders by translating complex data into actionable insights and scalable analytical solutions.  
The role has no disciplinary responsibility and reports to the Manager Demand Planning.  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
Your Responsibilities  
1. Demand Forecasting & Advanced Analytics  

* Develop, maintain, and improve statistical forecasting and machine-learning models for demand planning.
* Integrate statistical forecasts with market intelligence, customer information, commercial input, promotions, and business assumptions.
* Analyze historical demand, trends, seasonality, outliers, demand variability, and forecast bias.
* Identify the key drivers influencing demand and quantify their impact on forecast performance.
* Evaluate and improve forecasting approaches through back-testing, scenario analysis, and model benchmarking.
* Monitor forecast accuracy, forecast value added (FVA), bias, and other relevant planning KPIs.
* Challenge forecast figures from the business, other regions, and intercompany sources using data-driven insights.
* Support the definition and implementation of Make-to-Stock, Make-to-Order, or related supply strategies through analytical recommendations.
* Develop demand scenarios, sensitivity analyses, and risk assessments to support tactical and strategic decision-making.

2. Multi-Source Demand Signal Analysis & Reconciliation  

* Provide the analytical basis for combining multiple demand signal types into one coherent base forecast, including contracted/committed volumes, Lead-to-Order (LTO) pipeline volumes, customer-specific forecasts, and material-level statistical forecasts.
* Analyze and quantify the certainty, time horizon, and granularity differences between demand signal types, and provide data-driven recommendations to support the design and calibration of the demand hierarchy/waterfall logic owned by Demand Planning.
* Identify and flag inconsistencies, double-counting, or gaps between top-down (customer/portfolio) and bottom-up (material/SKU) demand layers, and provide analysis to support their resolution.
* Analyze historical LTO pipeline conversion behavior (e.g., conversion rates, typical phase-in timing) to support appropriate probability-weighting of pipeline volumes relative to contracted volumes.
* Analyze historical patterns of how annual/yearly contract volumes split into monthly (or other sub-annual) quantities, to improve the time-phasing accuracy of contracted demand.
* Analyze and document how incoming customer orders consume the statistical/base forecast over time (forecast consumption logic), and identify opportunities to improve its accuracy and transparency.
* Analyze how push-driven (“crop-driven”) business — volume determined by raw material availability/harvest timing rather than pull demand — is incorporated into the forecast, and run dedicated analytics to improve its treatment and accuracy.

3. Data Preparation & Quality Management  

* Ensure the quality, consistency, and completeness of demand, customer, material, sales, inventory, and supply chain data.
* Perform history cleansing and establish robust processes for identifying and treating outliers, one-off events, stock-outs, and exceptional demand.
* Support the integration of new customers, materials, products, flows, and data sources into IBP and related planning systems.
* Manage and improve statistical forecast parameters, including model selection, aggregation levels, time horizons, and forecast frequencies.
* Monitor data pipelines and investigate data inconsistencies affecting planning outputs.
* Establish standards for data preparation, documentation, version control, and reproducible analysis.

4. Business Partnership & Decision Support  

* Translate business questions and planning challenges into analytical requirements and practical data science solutions.
* Interface with Sales, Account Management, Business Units, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Finance, Controlling, and Operations on forecasting and planning topics.
* Support the analysis of business complaints relating to forecasts and new product introductions.
* Collaborate with Sales and R&D to obtain and validate LTO pipeline data at the appropriate stage of maturity for inclusion in the combined demand forecast.
* Analyze open contract quantities against call-offs and forecast figures in collaboration with Account Managers and business stakeholders.
* Support the development of a single, aligned forecast across Sales, Finance, Demand Planning, and Supply Chain.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer collaboration and create longer-term visibility of customer demand.
* Present analytical findings, assumptions, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Build strong working relationships and promote data-driven decision-making across the organization.

5. Strategic Planning & Modelling  

* Develop future demand projection models to support the five-year planning process.
* Support tactical and strategic demand planning for regional capacity analysis and capacity-related conclusions.
* Perform product and customer lifecycle analysis, including new product introductions, phase-ins/phase-outs, portfolio changes, and monitoring relevant system and master-data changes.
* Support business scenario planning, including demand upside/downside scenarios, supply constraints, customer changes, and market risks.
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and process improvement in demand planning and IBP.
* Develop dashboards, reports, and self-service analytical tools for planning and business stakeholders.
* Ensure analytical solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with business and IT standards.

 **Qualifications**

* Completed degree in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Applied Economics, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable quantitative field.
* 3–5 years of professional experience in data science, advanced analytics, demand planning, supply chain analytics, forecasting, or a related field.
* Strong expertise in statistical forecasting, time-series analysis, predictive modelling, and trend analysis.
* Practical experience applying machine-learning techniques to business or supply chain problems.
* Strong programming skills in Python or R.
* Good knowledge of SQL and experience working with structured and large-scale datasets.
* Experience with data visualization and dashboarding tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent.
* Sound understanding of demand planning, IBP/S&OP, supply chain processes, inventory management, and forecast performance measurement.
* Experience working with ERP, APS, IBP, or planning sys

**Job Description:** Pharmaceutical Formulation Consultant (Tablets & Capsules, NPD)

**Engagement type:** Consultant, project-based

**Work location:** Chennai office (on-site)

**Domain:** Pharmaceutical drug formulation and new product development (oral solid dosage)

**Duration:** Project-based, to be defined at onboarding (extendable)

**1. Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Pharmaceutical Formulation Consultant to develop new tablet and capsule products. The consultant will work from our Chennai office for the project duration. The role covers hands-on formulation preparation along with market research that supports product selection and positioning.

**2. Eligibility**

* **Freshers are not eligible to apply.**
* **Minimum 3+ years of hands-on, practical experience in formulation** (lab-level preparation and trials for tablets and/or capsules).
* Candidates with only theoretical or academic exposure, or with experience limited to QC, QA, or regulatory work, will not be considered.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Formulation Development (Tablets & Capsules)**

* Design and develop oral solid dosage formulations (immediate-release, and modified or sustained-release where applicable) for new products.
* Conduct pre-formulation studies: API characterisation, solubility, compatibility, and excipient selection.
* Personally prepare lab-scale formulation trials and optimise them using QbD / DoE principles.
* Select the manufacturing process (direct compression, wet or dry granulation, capsule filling) and define critical process parameters.
* Evaluate and troubleshoot trial batches: hardness, friability, disintegration, dissolution, assay, and content uniformity.
* Run stability studies as per ICH guidelines and interpret the results.
* Prepare formulation documents: Master Formula, development reports, and technical data packages.
* Support scale-up and tech transfer to the manufacturing site.

**B. Market Research**

Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because **Good Health Can’t Wait**.

We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.

For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).

‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency

Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in.
