**Job Title: Procurement Executive (Nutraceutical expertise)**

**Company: Nutrition shoppe**

**Location:** Mohali

**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Nutrition shoppe** is a leading nutraceutical plant dedicated to developing and manufacturing high-quality dietary supplements and health products. Our commitment to innovation, quality, and sustainability drives us to seek a dynamic and experienced Procurement Executive to join our team.

**Position Overview:** The Procurement Executive will be responsible for managing the procurement processes for raw materials, packaging, and other supplies necessary for the production of nutraceutical products. This role involves ensuring that all procurement activities align with company objectives and industry regulations while maintaining cost-effectiveness and quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Sourcing and Vendor Management:**
* Identify and evaluate potential suppliers and vendors for raw materials, packaging, and other essential items.
* Negotiate terms, prices, and delivery schedules with suppliers.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers to ensure consistent supply and resolve any issues that arise.
* **Purchase Order Management:**
* Create, issue, and manage purchase orders for required materials and supplies.
* Monitor order status and track delivery schedules to ensure timely receipt of goods.
* Coordinate with the production and quality assurance teams to align procurement activities with production needs.
* **Quality and Compliance:**
* Ensure that all procured materials meet the company’s quality standards and comply with relevant regulations and industry standards.
* Work with the Quality Assurance team to address any quality issues or non-conformities.
* **Inventory Management:**
* Monitor and manage inventory levels to prevent shortages or excess stock.
* Implement and maintain inventory control procedures to optimize stock levels and minimize costs.
* **Cost Management:**
* Analyze market trends and pricing to make informed procurement decisions.
* Implement cost-saving initiatives and seek opportunities for supplier cost reductions.
* **Documentation and Reporting:**
* Maintain accurate records of procurement activities, including supplier contracts, purchase orders, and inventory levels.
* Prepare and present regular reports on procurement performance, including cost analysis and savings achieved.
* **Collaboration and Communication:**
* Collaborate with other departments, such as Production, R&D, and Logistics, to ensure seamless integration of procurement activities with overall business operations.

**Qualifications:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
* **Experience:** Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in procurement, preferably within the nutraceutical or pharmaceutical industry.
* **Skills:** Strong negotiation and communication skills, excellent organizational abilities, and proficiency in procurement software and Microsoft Office Suite.
* **Knowledge:** Understanding of industry regulations, quality standards, and supply chain management principles.
* **Attributes:** Detail-oriented, proactive, and able to work independently as well as part of a team.

**Description**

**Who is USP?**

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

**Brief Job Overview**

The Director of Product Management is a managerial position that supports the global growth of USP’s material products including Reference Standards, Analytical Reference Materials, Pharmaceutical Analytical Impurities, Certified Reference Materials and the Materials Strategy Program across the USP Novel Medicines, Generics, and Consumer Health business units.

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.

* Serve as a strategic advisor to senior leadership by bringing a deep understanding of customer needs, market dynamics, and organizational priorities into decision-making.
* Sponsor customer and market insight initiatives to strengthen strategic planning, innovation, and commercial decision-making.

Market, Customer & Competitive Intelligence

* Shape portfolio strategy through deep understanding of industry trends, regulatory developments, market shifts, and emerging technologies.
* Champion customer-centric decision-making by translating voice-of-customer insights and market intelligence into strategic growth opportunities.
* Lead competitive intelligence efforts to identify market opportunities, differentiation strategies, and areas for innovation and investment.
* Partner with Commercial, Marketing, and Regional leaders to evaluate market potential, customer adoption trends, and evolving value propositions across the portfolio.

Product Development & Launch Leadership

* Provide leadership and governance for cross-functional product development initiatives, ensuring alignment across R&D, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, and Commercial functions.
* Establish strategic product requirements, launch objectives, and success criteria that align customer outcomes with business goals.
* Oversee enterprise-wide launch strategies and commercialization plans, ensuring organizational readiness and successful market adoption.
* Drive continuous improvement of innovation and commercialization processes to accelerate growth, improve launch performance, and maximize return on investment.

jobs.title: Head of Compliance & Regulatory (Only from food, edible oils, specialty fats, FMCG and nutrition Industry)
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
Manorama Industries Limited is a global supplier of Cocoa Butter Equivalents (CBE) and a pioneer in specialty fats and oils derived from tree-borne seeds such as Sal, Mango, Kokum, and Shea. Established in 2005 and backed by over four decades of industry experience, the company has built a robust geographic sourcing network across India and West Africa, ensuring reliable access to raw materials and resilience against supply-demand and seasonal fluctuations. Manorama is recognized for its advanced quality processes and standards, supported by modern R&D and product development technologies, enabling it to deliver high-performance solutions that closely mimic cocoa butter profiles. The company is committed to sustainable practices, including zero carbon emission initiatives and empowering tribal women through self-help groups, combining commercial success with social and environmental responsibility.

**Role Description**
Build and run the Company's compliance, risk and regulatory function as one office. Own the compliance framework and the enterprise risk register; ensure that every licence, approval, registration and certification required to make, import, export and sell the Company's specialty fats and new products is obtained and kept current; ensure products meet the regulatory requirements of their destination markets; and anticipate and manage regulatory risk across food safety, foreign trade, environment, factory/PESO and export market access — in coordination with the Company Secretary, Legal and the Occupier/Factory Manager.The Head of Compliance and Regulatory signs the Company's first compliance certificate to the Audit Committee in November 2027 and takes over as lead of the Board-approved compliance programme on joining. This full-time, on-site role based in Raipur involves developing and maintaining compliance frameworks, monitoring regulatory changes, and translating them into actionable policies and procedures. The role includes overseeing audits and inspections, coordinating with legal, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain teams, and preparing documentation for regulatory filings and certifications. Own FSSAI licensing (manufacturing, storage, import, export), product approvals, standards and labelling for all products; secure categorisation / approval for new products and manage any port-sampling / clearance representations. Own DGFT matters — IEC, Advance Authorisations and export-obligation compliance, RCMCs, status-holder and the Import SOP — and coordinate Customs and related representations with Legal and the Company Secretary.

**Qualifications**

•   About 18–25 years' experience, with 5+ years leading compliance, risk, regulatory affairs or internal audit at a listed company or a multinational's Indian business.

•   Hands-on FSSAI — licensing, product approvals, standards and labelling — and DGFT / EXIM (IEC, Advance Authorisations, export-obligation compliance, the import framework).

•   Export market-access experience, including clearing products for the EU.

•   Has designed and run a compliance register and law calendar; has reported to an Audit Committee or Board under challenge.

* Strong expertise in Compliance Management and Regulatory Compliance within food, edible oils, specialty fats, FMCG, or nutrition industries.
* In-depth understanding of relevant Regulations and Legal Compliance requirements at national and international levels.
* Advanced Analytical Skills to assess regulatory impact, interpret complex guidelines, and recommend practical solutions.
* Proven experience leading compliance or regulatory functions, preferably at a senior or head-of-department level.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law, Food Technology, Food Science, Nutrition, Chemistry, or a related discipline.
* Familiarity with global food safety and quality standards (e.g., FSSAI, Codex, HACCP, ISO, BRC or similar frameworks).
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions and locations.

At SBPL Goa, we combine scientific excellence with meaningful career growth opportunities, contributing directly to Syngenta's mission of feeding a growing world sustainably.

Lead the Analytical team of 5 to 6 scientists in delivering reliable, timely and compliant analytical support to Product Chemistry, Formulation Development, Technology & Sourcing, Manufacturing and Quality. The role requires strong technical expertise, structured problem solving, people leadership, and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders.

* Drive laboratory efficiency, robustness and continuous improvement through fit-for-purpose technologies, standardization, automation and lean ways of working.
* Ensure high-quality technical reports, analytical documentation and defensible scientific data to support product, process and regulatory decisions.

* Build a capable, engaged and inclusive Analytical team through clear objectives, regular feedback, coaching and performance management.
* Develop technical capability, succession pipelines and individual development plans using structured learning, peer learning and on-the-job experience.
* Promote a culture of scientific curiosity, ownership, collaboration, safety, quality and continuous improvement.
* Recruit, retain and develop talent; ensure appropriate competency assessment and training for laboratory roles.
* Lead by example in applying Syngenta behaviours and creating a respectful, diverse and rightful working environment. The internal people-management framework highlights talent development, coaching and inclusive leadership as core expectations.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner closely with Product Chemistry, Process Technology, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Supply, HSE and external laboratories/suppliers.

* Communicate complex analytical findings clearly and influence decisions at project, site and regional levels.

**Key Interfaces**

Internal: Product Chemistry, Process Technology, Manufacturing, Quality Assurance/Quality Control, Regulatory Affairs, HSE, Production & Supply Chain, Research, HR and Finance.  
External: Contract research/testing laboratories, equipment vendors, consultants, auditors and regulatory bodies.

 **Qualifications**  

* A PhD or Post Doc with specialization in Analytical Chemistry is preferred OR Organic chemistry or allied sciences qualification with high exposure to analytical and or formulation activity from a reputed institution in India or abroad. A 10+ years of experience analytical laboratory experience, including 5+ years leading teams or technical workstreams. OR
* Master’s degree in chemistry preferable analytical or allied Science, area from the reputed Universities with strong academic records and good communication skills Typically, 15+ years of relevant analytical laboratory experience, including 5+ years leading teams or technical workstreams.
* Deep practical experience with chromatographic and spectroscopic techniques, e.g., HPLC/UPLC, GC, LC-MS/GC-MS, IC, UV-Vis, IR and particle/physical-characterisation techniques as relevant to the function.

InspireXT is on a mission to become the world's most trusted supply chain consulting partner, and to create a company where our clients, our people and our partners flourish. We have lofty ambitions in an exciting market, where sustainability, efficiency, AI & technology enablement are driving bold collaborations in pursuit of customer excellence and profitable growth.

**WHY** **InspireXT****?**

Because transformation, at its best, is human. You’ll work with people who care deeply about what they do, who believe in trust before transactions, and who want to leave every client stronger than they found them. We are on a strong path of growth, and you’ll get to be part of that journey — helping shape the systems, culture, and capabilities that will scale with us. If that sounds like you – we’d love to hear from you. Apply to be part of our growth story.

Note - we are an equal opportunities employer, committed to fostering diversity & growth for all. We welcome applications from traditional and unusual backgrounds and also are happy to discuss any specific accommodations required in the recruitment process to help you shine.

Are you ready to inspire? #MakingWinners #InspireXT #SupplyChainExperts

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Food & Beverage Industry Subject Matter Expert (SME) with 15+ years of industry experience and strong domain expertise in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), product specification management, packaging development and regulatory compliance.

The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of end-to-end F&B product lifecycle processes, including product development, formulation, ingredient management, raw material specifications, packaging specifications, finished goods, quality management and product commercialization.

The candidate will play a critical role in providing functional and domain expertise for PLM transformation initiatives, helping translate business requirements into scalable digital solutions. The role will involve working closely with business stakeholders, product development teams, R&D, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Packaging, Manufacturing and IT teams.

A sound understanding of global food regulatory frameworks, particularly EU and USA regulations, is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

PLM & Product Lifecycle Management

  

* Provide subject matter expertise across the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation and product development to commercialization and product maintenance.
* Understand and define PLM processes covering product development, formulation, ingredient management, product specifications, quality and change management.
* Drive standardization of PLM processes, workflows, approval mechanisms and governance across business functions.
* Define business requirements and translate them into functional specifications for PLM platform implementation.
* Support PLM transformation initiatives, process optimization and digitalization programmes.

Product Specification Management

  

* Demonstrate strong expertise in managing product specifications across raw materials, ingredients, intermediates, finished goods and packaging materials.
* Understand specification attributes, technical data, nutritional information, allergen declarations, composition, physical and chemical properties and quality parameters.
* Define and manage specification lifecycle processes, including creation, review, approval, version control and obsolescence.
* Understand specification relationships, hierarchies, inheritance, dependencies and cross functional data requirements.
* Establish governance for specification accuracy, completeness, traceability and data integrity.

Packaging Management

  

* Provide functional expertise in primary, secondary and tertiary packaging processes and specifications.
* Understand packaging materials, structures, dimensions, weights, artwork, labeling, packaging components and material compliance.
* Support packaging development, packaging change management, supplier collaboration and packaging approval processes.
* Understand packaging sustainability, recyclability, material composition and environmental compliance requirements.
* Work with packaging engineering, procurement, quality and regulatory teams to define packaging specifications and associated workflows.

Global Regulatory & Compliance Requirements

  

* Possess a sound understanding of food safety, product labeling, ingredient declarations, packaging compliance and regulatory requirements across global markets.
* Understand supplier declarations, Certificates of Analysis (CoA), Certificates of Compliance (CoC), Statements of Composition and Declarations of Conformity (DoC).
* Work with regulatory teams to ensure product and packaging specifications capture relevant compliance attributes and documentation.
* Familiarity with EU regulatory frameworks, including:

* EU Regulation 178/2002 – General Food Law.
* EU Regulation 1169/2011 – Food Information to Consumers.
* EU Regulation 1935/2004 – Food Contact Materials.
* EU Regulation 10/2011 – Plastic Materials Intended to Come into Contact with Food.
* EU Regulation 2025/40 – Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR).
* REACH and applicable chemical substance compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with USA regulatory frameworks, including:

* FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA).
* FDA 21 CFR requirements applicable to food and food packaging.
* Food allergen labelling requirements under FALCPA and FASTER Act.
* FDA food contact substance requirements.
* Nutrition Facts and ingredient declaration requirements.
* Applicable food packaging and labelling compliance requirements.

Business Process & Stakeholder Management

* Engage with R&D, Product Development, Packaging, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Procurement and Supply Chain stakeholders.
* Conduct business workshops, discovery sessions, process assessments and fit-gap analysis.
* Document AS-IS and TO-BE business processes, functional requirements and process flows.
* Define business rules, approval workflows, roles and responsibilities.
* Support solution demonstrations, functional validation, UAT and business acceptance.
* Act as the domain bridge between business stakeholders and technology implementation teams.

PLM Platform Implementation & Transformation

  

* Provide functional leadership during PLM platform implementation and transformation programmes.
* Support configuration of product, ingredient, specification, packaging and regulatory management capabilities.
* Define functional requirements for data migration, integrations and reporting.
* Support product data governance, master data management and specification harmonization.
* Participate in solution design reviews, sprint planning, testing, defect resolution and deployment.
* Support user training, change management and post-implementation stabilization.

**Key Deliverables**

  

* Business process assessment and AS-IS / TO-BE documentation.
* Functional requirements and PLM solution design inputs.
* Product, ingredient, raw material and finished goods specification models.
* Packaging specification and lifecycle management processes.
* Regulatory and compliance requirement mapping for EU and USA markets.
* Functional workflows, approval processes and change management definitions.
* Data migration mapping and specification governance inpu

*Welcome diversity and apply as you are!*

*At Adisseo, we cherish the value of diversity whatever it may be.*

**Mission and main stakes**

* The Area Technical Manager oversees the technical support of Adisseo product & service portfolio in the states of Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka & Kerala and can be based at Hyderabad or Coimbatore.
* The ATM support will consist in training Adisseo sales and marketing forces as well as partners (distributors and agents). The ATM will help the sales forces in explaining and convincing customers and prospects in the values of Adisseo products and services. Together with the ASM he elaborates the targets and actions to retain and develop Adisseo’s market.
* The ATM will also oversee supporting and developing the technical network in the sub-region through contacts with Key Opinion Leaders and consultants based on mutual expertise, recognition and trust.
* The ATM will speak and present the technical specificities of the products to conferences, congresses, and any other professional events.
* The ATM defines and implements technical action plans to provide the most appropriate technical support to customers and partners for the existing product line. The ATM will actively contribute to the achievement of sales objectives in the sub-region together with the ASM, the Specialty Technical Sales managers and the partners’ sales force.
* Besides, the ATM has a key role to play, being the relay of Adisseo R&D department in the field. The ATM will have the responsibility not only to carry out appropriate trials to demonstrate product features, services and superiority but also to adapt the technical offer to fit customer expectations. Always in contact with customers, experts, KOLs, scholar… the ATM may also be at the origin of new ideas, concepts, and services.
* The ATM will be a key provider of needs for R&D departments and adapting the technical offer to fit the customer value.

**The Position**

* High level of responsibility and autonomy
* Transversal position directly and strongly interacting with numerous professions and interlocutors
* Solid intercultural management capacities

**Key Responsibilities**

* To coordinate technically the network of Area Sales Managers, and Global/Regional Category Managers and contributes to the training of our teams & distributors and agents
* To adapt technical presentations, messages and services to the different segments of customers and countries in interaction with the Global/Regional Category Manager
* To support the sales team with GKA and in specific cases to contribute to the success of the sales
* To remain the preferred contact with the KOL & consultants of the different countries/together with the local Adisseo representative or partner
* To develop the knowledge of the area in a customer centric way
* To interact with Marketing and R&D to optimize the knowledge and consideration of customer needs in the innovation dynamic
* To develop his/her external network with key opinion leaders and consultants in line with the business strategy
* To act as a guest speaker at workshops and external conferences
* To write scientific and technical articles in professional and international press
* To propose, implement, pilot and follow-up development trials for new specialties
* To ensure the reporting and the communication of the trials’ results to internal and external technical sales network

**Accountability**

The ATM is accountable for

* Training technically the Adisseo sales and marketing forces, and the distributor/agent representatives.
* Defining and providing technical services and support to customers, distributors and agents
* Elaborating and follow up technical action plans with both HQ and regions to develop and consolidate the products and services

**Internal/External relationships**

* Internal:
* HQ level: R&D, Regulatory affairs, Lab, BUs and Global Category Managers, global marketing, global ATM network
* Regional level: STSM, Area Managers, Country Managers, Regional Category Managers, Technologists

External: KOL, GKA and key customers, agents & distributors, …

**Profile Requirements**

* Post graduation in poultry Nutrition or poultry science, Veterinarian
* Experience: Confirmed experience in formulation as Formulator / Nutritionist / Technical Manager within an industrial firm specialized in animal feed: feed manufacturer, pre-mixer, feed additives. Animal Physiology and animal health strong knowledge. Strong poultry nutrition and husbandry knowledge. Strong ability to adapt to changing situations (multicultural and multi knowledge levels interlocutors). Ability to define, implement and follow a nutrition trial protocol on animals
* Good communication skills
* Team spirit
* Fluent in English (spoken and written)
* The position will be located ideally in the assigned area
* At least 70% of the time travelling

**What We Offer**

* Inclusive & diverse Culture: Be part of a multicultural and global team of 62 nationalities, operating in 100+ countries, that values diversity, promotes inclusion, and supports work-life balance in a respectful and safe work environment.
* Benefits: care program, vacation & paid time off, profit-sharing and performance incentives.
* Learning & Career Development: benefit from continuous training, mentoring, and learning programs, with equal access to career advancement and leadership opportunities.
* Sustainable and innovative company: work on meaningful projects using cutting-edge technology, with the freedom to innovate and make a real difference. Because we contribute to feeding 8 billion people, sustainability is not an option - it is our ambition.

jobs.title: Microbiologists
jobs.description:
**About The Hershey Company**
The Hershey Company (NYSE: HSY) is an industry-leading snacks company known for making more moments of goodness through its iconic brands. With a strong portfolio across chocolate, confectionery, and salty snacks, Hershey delights consumers every day. Our beloved brands include Hershey’s, Reese’s, KitKat®, Dots Pretzels, Lesser Evil, Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, Ice Breakers, and more.
  
  
At Hershey, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in the communities where we live, work, and do business. This commitment originated with our founder, Milton Hershey, and continues to shape who we are today.
  
  
Guided by our employee value proposition,
**Lead Today. Create Tomorrow,**
we empower our people to drive impact now while shaping what comes next. Our
**One Hershey**
mindset brings teams together across functions, geographies, and businesses, enabling us to operate with speed, collaboration, and shared purpose.
  
  
The Hershey Company is proud to be recognized as a top employer in the United States, reflecting our commitment to our people, culture, and purpose.
  
  
**How will you fit in the big picture?**
The Senior Microbiologist is responsible for microbiological quality assurance and food safety activities across six manufacturing lines and ten SKUs. The role supports product safety and release by leading microbiological sampling and testing, environmental and hygiene monitoring, laboratory and shift activities, audit readiness, documentation, corrective actions, GMP implementation, and microbiology performance reporting.
  
  
**What will you do?**
Perform online sampling and microbiological analysis of ingredients, semi-finished products, and finished products.
  
  
Manage the Environmental Microbiological Monitoring Program (EMMP), personnel hygiene monitoring, and ATP monitoring.
  
  
Support validation of cleaning and sanitation programs and troubleshoot microbiological issues.
  
  
Manage microbiology shift activities and maintain microbiology laboratory management system documentation and records.
  
  
Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) and corrective and preventive action (CAPA) meetings for microbiological issues, follow up actions, and report outcomes.
  
  
Handle and report proficiency testing activities and verify microbiology records.
  
  
Conduct weekly and monthly GMP and personnel hygiene audits and support audit readiness.
  
  
Train food handlers on GMP and encourage a Right First Time quality culture.
  
  
Perform trend analysis of plant microbiology issues and prepare monthly KPI and data reports.
  
  
Support SAP release of finished goods.
  
  
**Minimum Education & Requirements**
Experience:
  
  
Minimum 4-5 years of experience handling microbiological analysis of food products and/or beverages. Sound microbiology knowledge and ability to troubleshoot microbiological issues are required, along with team management, influencing, and communication skills.
  
  
Education:
  
  
M.Sc. in Microbiology.
  
  
**Benefits And Perks**
At Hershey, we offer competitive pay and a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your wellbeing, financial security, and life outside of work.
  
  

* Health & Wellbeing: Medical plus wellness programs that support your physical and mental health
* Financial Security: Competitive pay, annual incentive opportunities
* Time Off & Flexibility: Paid time off, company holidays, and flexible ways of working where applicable
* Growth & Development: Career development programs, learning opportunities, and internal mobility

*Benefits may vary based on role, location, and eligibility.*

jobs.title: Senior Lead Toxicologist
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
Are you passionate about service excellence? Would you love to work for a global organization that is doing more good for people and planet?
  
  
IFF is a global leader in Flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences, we deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.
  
  
Taste: Crafting unique, technology-enabled flavor designs that define the identity of food and beverage brands, shape trends in flavor building and fuel market success.
  
  
The role is based in Mumbai, India. Be part of a creative, solution-oriented team where together we can achieve greatness and make a real impact. Your potential is our inspiration.
  
  
**Where You’ll Make a Difference**

* Provide toxicology support for taste (flavor) ingredients, products, and related business areas.
* Conduct toxicology and safety assessments for flavor ingredients across global markets.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including R&D, Regulatory, Quality, Commercial, and Creative functions.
* Design and coordinate toxicology testing strategies to support regulatory approvals and new ingredient registrations.
* Develop scientific approaches to support and defend ingredients and products across global regions.
* Monitor toxicology studies to ensure compliance with applicable testing guidelines, regulatory requirements, and best practices.
* Review toxicity study reports and evaluate scientific data to ensure accurate, evidence-based conclusions.
* Translate complex toxicological findings into clear recommendations for scientific, regulatory, commercial, and customer audiences.
* Represent the organization with industry associations, regulatory agencies, and external stakeholders while providing support for customer toxicology inquiries.

**What Makes You The Right Fit**

* PhD or MSc in Toxicology, Pharmacology, or a related scientific discipline.
* Professional certifications such as DABT, ERT, or equivalent toxicology credentials are highly valued.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with fluency in English.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
* Demonstrated organizational, prioritization, and project management capabilities.
* Broad experience in toxicology, including repeat-dose, genotoxicity, and reproductive/developmental toxicity studies.
* Knowledge of food, flavor, fragrance, scent, or related consumer product industries.
* Familiarity with global flavor regulations and guidelines, including FDA, FEMA, EU, and CODEX frameworks.
* Expertise in computational toxicology, risk assessment methodologies, and flavor and fragrance chemistry.

**How Would You Stand Out?**

* Advanced expertise in toxicology, risk assessment, and computational toxicology, supported by strong scientific knowledge and analytical capabilities.
* Experience supporting flavor, food, fragrance, or consumer product industries, with a solid understanding of global regulatory requirements and ingredient safety assessments.
* Proven ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams, communicate complex scientific information to diverse audiences, and build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

**Why Choose Us?**

* Work in a global organization that values innovation and sustainability.
* Hybrid work model offering flexibility and balance.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development.

We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. At IFF, we believe that your uniqueness unleashes our potential. We value the diverse mosaic of the ethnicity, national origin, race, age, sex, or veteran status. We strive for an inclusive workplace that allows each of our colleagues to bring their authentic self to work regardless of their religion, gender identity & expression, sexual orientation, or disability.
  
  
Visit IFF.com/careers/workplace-diversity-and-inclusion to learn more

jobs.description:
**About GoKhana - ToBox Ventures Pvt Ltd:**

GoKhana is a full-stack B2B technology company that manages end-to-end food programs for corporates and enables the Next-Gen Digitized Cafeteria. Bringing together an imaginative blend of technology, logistics and food service management, GoKhana offers SaaS solutions to digitize corporate cafeterias and eateries in tech park. GoKhana’s award-winning solution brings our food partners, corporate partners, and their employees on a single, transparent platform. GoKhana is built around the principle of simplicity. Whether it is the simplicity of solving problems, eliminating the need for multiple apps for outlet types, or the absolutely intuitive ease of using the app. Website: www.gokhana.com

**About Health & Safety Executive:**

The Sr. Executive - HSEQ will play a critical role in ensuring that our food vendor partners and cafeteria operations comply with all food safety regulations and standards. This position involves implementing, monitoring, and improving food safety protocols to maintain the highest levels of hygiene and safety in all food handling processes.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Execute Food Safety audit as per FSSAI requirement.
* Execute the monthly Audit and Conduct customized audit across Catering/Base Kitchen Audits/ Live kitchen Audits & Submit the report.
* Follow up of NC closure for both external and internal audits.
* Ensure developed corrective action on nonconformities are implemented effectively.
* Verify the corrective action implementation effectiveness.
* Coordinating with the clients (existing & new) for any HSEQ-related matters/ queries.
* Helping mobilization of new sites for region by ensuring adherence to all HSE & QA related processes required for successful mobilization.
* Co-coordinating with Operation team / process owners for all HSEQ-related methods for effective Implementation of FSMS in site and support in the External Client Audits at sites such as Health First Audit & ISO Audits & in Vendor Transition.
* Reducing the customer complaints to the lowest level by establishing the proper control of all food safety hazards at the kitchens of Vendor partners at site or Base kitchen.
* Conduct training as per the "Training Calendar" and monthly reporting of the training activities and updating on Tracker.
* Ensuring the Quality Development in the Supply Chain for Vendors (existing and new) through new vendor audits, Existing Vendor Audits, review of the supplied material quality and supply chain/ process and conducting Vendor awareness training sessions on HSE and QA parameters.
* Implementing the FSMS system in the vendor kitchen by conducting daily checks at the kitchen, maintaining sanitization and cleaning of the vendor kitchen and deliver safe and hygienic food to the client.
* Maintaining and updating the Food safety and quality records.
* Ensuring the Quality Development in the Supply Chain for Vendors (existing and new) through vendor audits, review of the supplied material quality and supply chain/ process and conducting Vendor awareness training sessions on HSE and QA parameters.

**Prerequisites:**

* Educational Qualification – Bachelor’s Degree in food science and technology or Microbiology or Hotel management or catering technology from recognized university.
* Preference would be given if acquired Accredited Lead Auditor Course in food safety Management System (ISO22000/FSSC22000).
* Should have sufficient Knowledge of FSS Act and regulation.
* Must have sector specific knowledge regarding Hygiene, Sanitary practices, process knowledge, Allergen management, etc.
* Certified internal auditor on ISO 22000 / HACCP.
* Knowledge in Quality and Food Safety Management System.

jobs.title: Legal Executive -(Paralegal Agreements & Compliance)
jobs.description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Legal Executive / Paralegal who can support the company in managing agreements, legal documentation, compliance tracking and coordination with internal departments and external lawyers.

The candidate should be detail-oriented, organised and capable of independently maintaining legal records, agreement trackers, compliance calendars and first-level review of commercial documents. The role will require regular follow-up with internal teams, vendors, landlords, consultants and external legal advisors.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Agreement Management**

* Maintain a complete tracker of all company agreements, including vendor agreements, mall agreements, lease agreements, distributor agreements, service contracts, NDAs, employment-related agreements and other commercial documents.
* Review agreements at a first level and highlight key legal and commercial points such as tenure, lock-in, notice period, termination, indemnity, liability, jurisdiction, renewal, payment terms and penalties.
* Prepare agreement summaries for management approval.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external lawyers for drafting, review, negotiation and closure of agreements.
* Ensure proper execution, stamping, signing and storage of all agreements.
* Track agreement expiry dates, renewal dates and notice period deadlines.

**2. Compliance Management**

* Prepare and maintain a compliance calendar for all company-level requirements.
* Coordinate for statutory and regulatory compliances such as ROC, GST, shop & establishment, labour law, factory licences, legal metrology, trademark, FSSAI or other applicable business compliances.
* Follow up with concerned departments to ensure timely submission of documents and completion of compliance tasks.
* Maintain proper digital and physical records of licences, renewals, filings and approvals.
* Escalate pending or critical compliance matters to management in a timely manner.

**3. Legal Coordination**

* Coordinate with external lawyers, consultants, company secretary, auditors and other advisors.
* Assist in handling legal notices, disputes, vendor issues and documentation-related matters.
* Prepare basic legal letters, authorisation letters, board resolution drafts, POAs and internal notes wherever required.
* Maintain confidentiality of all legal, commercial and company-sensitive documents.

**4. Internal Process & Documentation**

* Create and maintain structured folders for all legal documents.
* Prepare MIS reports for pending agreements, expiring agreements, compliance status and legal matters.
* Follow up with internal teams for pending inputs, documents and approvals.
* Ensure that no agreement, renewal or compliance deadline is missed.

**Required Skills**

* Good understanding of basic commercial agreements and legal clauses.
* Strong drafting and communication skills.
* Good follow-up ability with internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills for maintaining trackers.
* Ability to read agreements carefully and identify risk areas.
* Organised, detail-oriented and deadline-driven.
* Comfortable coordinating with multiple departments.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership.

**Preferred Experience**

* 7-8 years of experience in legal documentation, paralegal work, agreement management or compliance coordination.
* Prior experience in a company, law firm, retail, FMCG, manufacturing, real estate, mall leasing or corporate legal department will be preferred.
* Experience with vendor agreements, lease agreements, mall agreements, distributor agreements and compliance calendars will be an advantage.

**Qualification**

* LLB / Legal studies background preferred.
* Candidates with strong paralegal or legal documentation experience may also be considered.

Pay: ₹700,000.00 - ₹900,000.00 per year

Benefits:

jobs.title: Asst. Manager QA/QC
jobs.description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* **Raw Material & Packaging Inspection:** Conduct thorough quality checks on incoming raw materials (grains, pulses, edible oils, spices, seasonings) and packaging materials against approved specifications before releasing them for production.
* **In-Process Quality Control (IPQC):** Monitor critical control points across frying, baking, extrusion, seasoning, and packaging lines—including moisture content, oil absorption, free fatty acids (FFA), peroxide value, salt/seasoning levels, organoleptic parameters, and seal integrity.
* **Finished Goods & Shelf-Life Testing:** Perform final batch inspections, net weight checks, metal detector verification, and accelerated shelf-life studies prior to dispatch.

With 124 contemporary rooms, including four suites and a Presidential Suite, the hotel offers modern amenities, versatile event spaces, a rooftop infinity pool and fully equipped health club. Just minutes from New Delhi Railway Station, 45 minutes from Indira Gandhi International Airport, and well connected to the city's key business hubs, the hotel offers easy access to Delhi's cultural, shopping, and entertainment destinations.

The hotel boasts a range of stylish rooms and luxurious suites. Guests can indulge in diverse dining experiences, unwind with refreshing drinks at the Gourmet Bar, stay active at the health club and enjoy flexible meeting spaces.

 **Job Description**

The Cost Controller will play a crucial role in ensuring the efficient management of food and beverage costs, monitoring inventory levels, analyzing cost variances, implementing cost-saving initiatives, and optimizing profitability while maintaining high-quality standards in hotel operations.

* Oversee the procurement, storage, and issuance of food and beverage inventory to ensure adequate stock levels while minimizing waste and spoilage.

Job Description – Freelance Content Writer

**Company:** Delhi Chai Cafe  
**Position:** Freelance Content Writer (Website & SEO)  
**Employment Type:** Freelance / Project-Based  
**Work Mode:** Remote  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years (Preferred)

About the Role

Delhi Chai Cafe is looking for a creative, research-oriented, and result-driven Freelance Content Writer who can develop engaging, informative, and SEO-optimised content for the company's website and digital platforms.

The candidate will be responsible for creating website content that communicates the brand's identity, products, services, franchise opportunities, and business offerings while ensuring that the content is structured to improve search engine visibility and organic website traffic.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Website Content Development**

* Write and develop engaging content for different sections of the company website.
* Create content for Home, About Us, Our Products, Franchise Opportunities, Contact Us, and other relevant website pages.
* Ensure all website content reflects the company's brand identity, values, and business objectives.
* Write compelling product descriptions, brand introductions, and service-related content.
* Review and update existing website content wherever required.

**2. SEO Content Writing**

* Develop SEO-friendly content using relevant keywords and search terms.
* Conduct keyword research to identify high-ranking and relevant keywords.
* Optimise website pages with appropriate headings, meta titles, meta descriptions, and keyword placement.
* Write SEO-focused blogs and articles to improve organic search rankings.
* Implement internal linking and follow basic on-page SEO practices.
* Ensure content is original, plagiarism-free, readable, and search-engine friendly.

**3. Blog & Article Writing**

* Research and write informative blogs and articles related to the QSR, café, food, beverage, hospitality, and franchise industries.
* Develop content around relevant industry trends, customer interests, and frequently searched topics.
* Create informative articles that improve brand awareness and website engagement.

**4. Content Research & Strategy**

* Research competitors and analyse their website content and SEO strategies.
* Identify content gaps and suggest new topics and website improvements.
* Maintain consistency in brand tone, language, and messaging.
* Coordinate with the company's marketing team to understand content requirements and campaign objectives.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Proven experience in website content writing and SEO content development.
* Strong command of English grammar, vocabulary, and sentence construction.
* Knowledge of SEO fundamentals, keyword research, and on-page optimisation.
* Familiarity with tools such as Google Keyword Planner, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar platforms.
* Ability to write engaging, informative, and conversion-oriented content.
* Strong research, editing, and proofreading skills.
* Ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple content assignments independently.
* Basic understanding of the food, café, hospitality, or QSR industry will be an added advantage.

**Note:** Candidates with practical experience in SEO-driven website content development will be preferred.

Pay: ₹2,000.00 - ₹4,000.00 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

\* Territory and market coverage growth

\* Partner sales growth and productivity

\* Collections and outstanding receivables

\* Partner retention and satisfaction

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  

“We Power the Magic!” That’s our motto at Disney Experiences (DX). Our team creates world-class immersive digital experiences for the Company’s premier vacation brands including Disney’s Parks & Resorts worldwide, Disney Cruise Line, Aulani, a Disney Resort & Spa, and Disney Vacation Club.

We are responsible for the end-to-end digital and physical Guest experience for all technology & digital-led initiatives across the Attractions & Entertainment, Food & Beverage, Resorts & Transportation and Merchandise lines of business as well as other initiatives including MyDisneyExperience and Hey, Disney!

As a Senior Software Engineer within Disney Experiences Technology, you will help create immersive digital products that bring Disney’s stories to life across theme parks, resorts, cruise vacations, and consumer experiences worldwide. In this role, you will operate as a skilled, independent worker who solves complex problems, mentors less experienced colleagues, and contributes effective, high-quality solutions that enhance guest and business experiences.

**Responsibilities:**

In this role, you will design, build, test, and maintain software solutions that support end-to-end guest and business journeys across Disney Experiences, from travel and vacation planning to in-park and retail interactions. You will work with minimal guidance, act as a resource for teammates, and apply your problem-solving skills to deliver effective, scalable systems that help Disney provide creative, customer-focused, and innovative experiences around the world. This role matters because it ensures our technology is reliable, performant, and easy to evolve, requiring a proficient engineer who is detail-oriented, collaborative, and able to explain complex concepts clearly.

* Conceive, design, develop, test, and implement software components, enhancements, fixes, and new applications across web and cloud-based platforms.
* Contribute to and sometimes lead the design and implementation of custom applications, integrations, microservices, and APIs that support high-volume, highly scalable systems.
* Work independently to deliver assigned tasks from planning through implementation, adapting to changing business requirements while maintaining code quality and performance.
* Participate in agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, demos, retrospectives) and collaborate with product, design, QA, and other stakeholders to define scalable, maintainable solutions.
* Perform regular code reviews, enforce coding standards, and support unit, behavioral, and integration testing to ensure high-quality, secure, and performant software.
* Monitor applications using tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics, or similar solutions, troubleshoot production issues, and proactively improve system reliability and run quality.
* Explain difficult or sensitive technical concepts to non-technical partners and collaborate across teams to align on requirements, architecture, and implementation approaches.
* Offer guidance and informal mentorship to junior engineers by sharing best practices, providing constructive feedback, and modeling effective problem-solving approaches.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Strong proficiency in Java for building production-grade, scalable applications and services.
* Experience developing front-end applications using JavaScript frameworks such as Angular and/or React, and back-end services using Node.js.
* Knowledge of microservices architectures, RESTful web services, and API design for high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems.
* Proficiency in object-oriented programming, design principles, and common design patterns for multi-tier web applications.
* Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging technologies such as Pub/Sub or Kafka.
* Strong knowledge of unit testing, behavioral or component testing, and continuous integration practices and tools.
* Experience using monitoring and logging tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics, New Relic, or similar platforms to support production systems.
* Ability to work effectively in agile teams, collaborate with cross-functional partners, and communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions.
* Minimum Required Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Years Of Experience: 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including full software development lifecycle responsibilities.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience developing cloud-based or cloud-native solutions using AWS or similar platforms, including managed and serverless technologies such as Docker, ECS, Lambda, or Kubernetes.
* Database design and implementation experience with both relational and NoSQL databases, such as MariaDB, DynamoDB, or MongoDB.
* Experience with QA and software analytics tools, CI/CD pipelines, and automated release management systems.
* Background in hospitality, travel, vacation ownership, licensing, or commerce-related domains.

  
**Disclaimer**  

This position is with Walt Disney Attractions Technology LLC, which is part of a business we call Disney Experiences.

To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here.

Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help.

**Role:** Field Service Representative (North)

**Location:** Gurgaon  
**Experience:** 3+ Years

**Must-Have Skills:**

Service support, chemical dosing, commissioning, and process troubleshooting in **WTP, STP, WWTP, RO, and cooling tower systems**. Strong knowledge of **water chemistry, scaling/corrosion control, microbiological treatment, and process optimization**.

Nalco Water, an Ecolab company, helps customers conserve more than 161 billion gallons of water annually. We serve industries from food & beverage to mining and manufacturing, delivering innovative solutions that reduce, reuse, and recycle water while protecting systems and equipment. Our team combines deep technical expertise with smart technology to drive efficiency, sustainability, and performance.

Ecolab is seeking a (**Field Service Representative III – Install OR Hygiene)** where your hands-on skills and customer-first mindset will help shape a more sustainable future. You’ll be part of a purpose-driven team that supports water treatment and disinfection systems across a variety of industries. You’ll work independently in the field, building trusted relationships with customers and delivering solutions that protect vital resources and improve operational performance.

**How You’ll Make an Impact (****add/remove applicable job duties****):**

* Provide technical support and escalate complex challenges as needed
* Build strong relationships with customers and promote best practices
* Ensure full compliance with safety policies and procedures
* Execute required chemistry tests, log, and report data, and maintain product inventories at customer accounts
* Provide routine service support to Sales Representatives in strategic district accounts to execute agreed upon customer system assurance plans
* Provide technical support to customers; identifying and resolving customer pain points, escalating as required

* Targeted accounts are within the **(specific division – ex: manufacturing, global high tech, downstream, etc.)**industries
* Up to **(XX)**% overnight travel

**What’s Unique About This Role:**

* You’ll work in a dynamic, hands-on environment with autonomy and support
* You’ll help customers meet sustainability goals while protecting their critical assets
* You’ll gain access to industry-leading training and development programs

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent

* Position requires a current and valid Driver’s License with no restrictions

* Exposure to hot, cold, noisy, or dirty environments
* Stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, balancing, walking, standing, climbing

* The ability to make an impact and **shape your career** with a company that is passionate about growth.

jobs.title: Application Chemist
jobs.description:
#### ***Toshvin Analytical is a place where opportunity meets growth. We believe in providing the best quality service to our clients and in turn, helping businesses grow. We are a team of experienced professionals, looking for bright, motivated and committed individuals.***

#### ***If you are interested in a long-term career with one of the leading instrumentation companies in India, please email your CV to:*** ***careers@toshvin.com***

  

**Position :** Application Chemist

**Reports to :** RM / SM

**Location :** Bangalore

**Minimum Years of Work Experience :** 2 years

**Maximum Years of Work Experience :** 8 years

**Minimum Qualification :** B.Sc. or equivalent Graduation in Organic Chemistry or Analytical Chemistry

**Prefered Qualification :** M.Sc. Or Equivalent Postgraduation in Organic/ Analytical Chemistry or higher

**Maximum Grade in Toshvin :** M1

**Type of Work Experience Required:** Experience in Chromato products

**Type of Work Experience Required:** Experience in GC, GCMS

**Responsibilities & Deliverables:**

* Responsible for providing post sale customer on-site application support on GC, GCMS & GCMS-MS
* Supporting customer method development / method optimisation assistance pertaining to their sample matrices
* Helping customer with method validation support , Trouble shooting of customers application issues
* Demonstrating to customers advanced software capabilities and method packages with sample matrices
* Coordinate with Principals local application lab for any support required to address any unresolved customers application requests
* Conducting application training to customers chemists for effective use and utilization of the system and software
* Preparing effective application support reports detailing activities carried out and final result achieved
* Preparing and making PowerPoint presentations as and when required to customer on application support activity carried out and result achieved

**General Success Behaviours:**

* **Accountability:** Takes ownership of tasks and responsibilities
* **Collaboration & Teamwork:** Works effectively with others across teams and departments
* **Communication:** Communicates clearly, effectively and professionally
* **Customer & Stakeholder Focus:** Understands the internal and external customer needs
* **Integrity & Ethics:** Acts honestly, maintains confidentiality and upholds company values
* **Results Orientation:** Works proactively, manages time to meet deadlines and priorities
* **Professionalism:** Upholds professional standards and represents the organisation positively
* **Organizational Awareness:** Keeps updated on the organization’s goals and industry trends

**Any specific skills/knowledge required for this position:**

* **1. Chromatography Expertise:**
* Hands-on experience in handling chromatography products such as Gas Chromatography (GC), GC with Headspace (GC-HS), Gas Chromatography–Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS), and Triple Quad Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS/MS). Should be comfortable in operating, troubleshooting, and maintaining these instruments
* Should have handled & managed reasonably sized field sales team members (4 to 5 & more) and also Managers (managing their team)
* **2. Sampling Techniques:**
* Familiarity with advanced sampling techniques such as Headspace Samplers, Thermal Desorption Units, Pyrolyzers, and other front-end sample introduction systems
* **3. Analytical Methodology:**
* Proven experience in analytical method development, optimization, and validation using GC, GC-MS, and GC-MS/MS platforms. Ability to design robust methods to address complex analytical challenges and ensure reproducibility
* **4. Application Knowledge by Industry Segment:**
* Understanding of typical application workflows aligned with specific industry requirements (e.g., pharmaceuticals, food & beverages, environmental, petrochemicals, forensic, or clinical research). Should be able to translate customer requirements into analytical solutions
* **5. Regulatory Knowledge:**
* Awareness of global regulatory standards and compliance requirements such as US FDA, EPA, ICH, USP, GLP, and ISO guidelines. Prior experience in working under regulated environments would be highly desirable
* **6. Sample Preparation Techniques:**
* Well-versed with diverse sample preparation methods including extraction (liquid-liquid, solid-phase), digestion, purification, derivatization, and clean-up techniques. Understanding of how these steps impact final analytical results is essential
* **7. Additional Desirable Skills:**
* a. Ability to handle complex data analysis and interpret mass spectral information. b. Familiarity with software platforms used in GC/GC-MS/GC-MS/MS workflows. c. Strong problem-solving aptitude with innovative thinking for method troubleshooting. d. Effective technical communication skills to support customers, teams, and training sessions

jobs.description:
Store & Purchase Executive

**Churchgate Hospitality Pvt. Ltd. | Mumbai | Full-time | On-site**

Company Description

Churchgate Hospitality Pvt. Ltd. (CHPL) is a hospitality-led brand house focused on creating distinct, experience-first dining concepts. Each restaurant is built with a clear identity, rooted in culture, refined through design, and elevated by attentive service and strong culinary execution.

The portfolio includes **Nksha**, an Art Deco-inspired North Indian fine dining concept; **Otoki**, a refined Japanese dining experience defined by precision and authenticity; **Tamak**, a bold North Indian concept centred on warmth and social dining; and **Fieno**, a contemporary Italian restaurant celebrating regional Italian cooking, quality ingredients and warm, refined hospitality.

CHPL approaches restaurant development as brand building rather than outlet expansion, ensuring each concept remains distinctive in character, culinary identity and guest experience.

Role Description

The **Store & Purchase Executive** is a full-time, on-site role based in Mumbai, responsible for procurement, receiving, inventory control and store operations across Churchgate Hospitality's restaurant portfolio.

The role works closely with chefs, restaurant managers, finance and vendors to ensure uninterrupted availability of food, beverage, packaging, operating supplies and other restaurant requirements while maintaining appropriate quality, pricing and stock levels.

The Store & Purchase Executive will manage purchase orders, vendor quotations, inward documentation, stock movements and periodic physical inventories. The role requires strong attention to **purchase prices, yields, wastage, consumption patterns and stock variances**, with timely reporting of discrepancies or unusual movements.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage daily and periodic **purchase requirements** across CHPL restaurants.
* Consolidate outlet indents and issue purchase orders based on approved requirements.
* Obtain and compare **multiple vendor quotations** to maintain competitive pricing and consistent specifications.
* Maintain approved vendor lists and negotiate pricing, credit terms, delivery schedules and product specifications.
* Coordinate closely with chefs and operations teams on availability and specifications of fresh produce, meat, seafood, dairy, imported ingredients, beverages and dry goods.
* Monitor purchase rates and immediately flag **significant price increases or supplier changes**.
* Receive materials and verify **quantity, quality, weight, specification, batch, expiry and condition** against purchase orders and invoices.
* Ensure strict **FIFO/FEFO** stock rotation and appropriate storage temperatures and conditions.
* Maintain GRNs, purchase orders, invoices, stock-transfer records, return notes and other store documentation.
* Maintain accurate records of **opening stock, inward, outward/issue, transfers, closing stock and consumption**.
* Conduct regular physical stock counts and reconcile them against system stock.
* Investigate and report **stock variances, excess consumption, shortages, damages, wastage and slow-moving items**.
* Monitor minimum, maximum and reorder levels to prevent both stock-outs and unnecessary overstocking.
* Coordinate inter-outlet stock transfers and maintain proper documentation for every movement.
* Work with Accounts to ensure invoices, purchase orders, GRNs and vendor statements are correctly reconciled.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and traceability for imported and high-value products.
* Support monthly **food cost and beverage cost closing** by providing accurate purchase, consumption and inventory data.
* Maintain store hygiene, organisation, labelling and food-safety standards.
* Assist management with monthly purchase analysis, vendor comparisons and opportunities for procurement savings.

Qualifications

* **2–5 years of experience** in purchasing, stores or inventory control, preferably within restaurants, hotels or hospitality.
* Strong understanding of **food and beverage purchasing and inventory management**.
* Knowledge of restaurant ingredients, especially meat, seafood, dairy, fresh produce, dry goods and imported products, is preferred.
* Experience with **PO, GRN, stock transfer, stock issue and inventory reconciliation** processes.
* Strong numerical ability and attention to detail.
* Proficiency in **Microsoft Excel**, particularly filters, lookups, pivot tables and inventory/purchase analysis.
* Familiarity with restaurant inventory/POS/ERP systems is preferred.
* Ability to negotiate confidently with vendors while maintaining strong supplier relationships.
* Understanding of **FIFO, FEFO, food safety, storage temperatures and hygiene standards**.
* Ability to identify unusual stock variances, price changes and consumption patterns.
* Diploma or degree in Hospitality, Supply Chain, Commerce or a related discipline preferred.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance will primarily be measured through:

* Purchase-price control and vendor competitiveness
* Product availability and reduction of stock-outs
* Inventory accuracy
* Stock variance and wastage control
* Timely PO/GRN/invoice processing
* Vendor delivery and quality performance
* Adherence to approved product specifications
* Monthly stock-closing accuracy
* Reduction of excess and slow-moving inventory
* Timely management reporting

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

* Provide reproducible development and evaluation environments, maintain operational documentation and runbooks, support retrieval pipelines and agent workflows, and contribute reusable DevOps tooling across engineering.

* 3+ years of experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

* Strong foundations in Linux, networking, containers, Git-based workflows, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD, with working proficiency in Python and familiarity with shell scripting.

* Experience supporting retrieval systems, vector databases, fine-tuning pipelines, GPU workloads, enterprise data governance, or the food, beverage, and supplements industry.

jobs.title: R&D and Innovation Packaging Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**
At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
  
  
**Summary:**
The R&D and Innovation Packaging Manager builds and leads a new pre-development and innovation capability within Product Operations. This role develops, pilots and proves packs, platforms and technologies before the brief, for launches two to three years ahead, so launch teams start from proven solutions instead of discovering risks late. It turns technical scouting, regulatory change such as the EU PPWR, and recurring quality issues into tested, ready-to-use solutions handed over to Packaging Development.
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
:
  
  
**R&D Strategy & Portfolio**

* Build the packaging R&D roadmap for Y+2 and Y+3 launches from the Brand roadmap, consumer and retailer feedback, quality issues, COPQ and technical scouting.
* Select topics that help launches, fix what customers feel, make us different and can be ready in time.
* Manage the R&D portfolio, budget and timelines; stop topics that no longer create value.

**Platforms & Technology**

* Pre-develop functionally proven platforms in key categories (e.g., closures, applicators, mascara, gloss, compacts, pumps, airless).
* Run pilot molds, functional and compatibility tests on our formulas, then homologate with Quality.
* Prove supplier standard packs on our formulas before they are used in launches.
* Build and maintain the Packs Library: proven platforms and standards, with design rules and test files.

**Advanced Development & Innovation**

* Scout new materials, mechanisms, suppliers and manufacturing technologies in line with the roadmap.
* Take ideas to feasible concepts and prototypes, with early risk assessment and filling and assembly implications.
* Assess supplier technical and innovation capability; Procurement leads commercial terms.
* Document new technologies and flag intellectual property opportunities to Legal.

**PPWR & Sustainable Design**

* Translate PPWR design requirements (recyclability, recycled content, minimisation) into design rules, materials and platforms, with Regulatory owning the interpretation.
* Qualify recyclable, mono-material and recycled-content solutions on our formulas, for function and compatibility.
* Build PPWR-ready options into the Packs Library and the materials library for Y+2 and Y+3 launches.
* Track delegated and implementing acts with Regulatory, and update standards when they change.
* Provide technical evidence for conformity documentation; conformity sign-off for each launch sits outside R&D.

**Kaizen & Product Performance**

* Use complaints, reviews, quality trends and COPQ to target issues that repeat across products.
* Develop and test permanent improvements in application, dosing, closing, comfort and robustness.
* Turn each proven fix into updated specifications, design rules and standards

**Handover & Governance**

* Define readiness criteria for handover to Packaging Development: function proven, compatibility tested, homologated and documented.
* Hand over only proven solutions, and support the first launches that use them.
* Use our specification tool and the risk score at R&D stage, in proportion to novelty.
* Protect R&D capacity: support live launches through agreed handovers only, and escalate any trade-off to the Director.

**Leadership and Coaching**

* Build, lead and develop a small R&D team of packaging engineers and technical design support.
* Manage external partners: designers, prototyping houses, test labs and technology partners.
* Build a culture of curiosity, rigor and evidence.

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Strategic Exposure**

* Partner with Product Development, Marketing, Design, Quality, Packaging Development, Procurement and Regulatory.
* Present the R&D pipeline, business cases and recommendations to leadership.
* Build long-term technical partnerships with innovative suppliers.

**Requirements**

* Proven record of taking new packaging concepts or technologies from prototype to industrial launch.
* Hands-on experience of pilot tooling, functional testing and formula/pack compatibility.
* Strong knowledge of materials, mechanisms and processes (injection, blow molding, assembly, decoration).
* Experience building platforms, standards or design rules used by development teams.
* Working knowledge of the EU PPWR and design-for-recycling guidelines (e.g., RecyClass).
* Network of innovative packaging suppliers and technology partners in Europe and Asia.
* Track record of building business cases and prioritizing with clear criteria.
* Able to review CAD models; experience with 3D printing and rapid prototyping.
* Track record of building a new function from scratch, with a curious, rigorous and evidence-based approach.
* 8+ years in packaging development, including significant pre-development or innovation experience in beauty, fragrance or luxury.
* Bachelor's/Master's in Packaging, Mechanical, Materials or Plastics Engineering, or Industrial Design.

**Benefits**

* Monthly "Self Love Days" - at company discretion
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting

*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*
